tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khros pa'i mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba'i rnam bshad rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rje btsun bla ma mnyes pa nyin mo bzhin// mi shes gnyid sangs shes byar blo rgyas pa'i// thabs kyi dam par dbang gyur des mdo rgyud// kun tu gsungs phyir rtse gcig de la skyabs// bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyi phyogs rnams g.yul ngor bsad pa'i drag shul chen pos 'jigs nas gang gi drung*// srid gsum srid pa'i bdag po rnams kyi mgo bos rab btud ci gsungs thod du bcings gus pa// rgyal ba'i rgyal thabs ma lus skyong mkhan rnam pa'i rol mo sku gsung thugs dang bde chen gyi// dkyil 'khor dkyil na 'jigs byed gtum pa'i gar mdzad de yis bdag la rtag tu bde legs mdzod// drag sngags dmod pa'i mtshon cha rnon po'i sde// legs bshad glang chen smyon pa'i snas bskor tshe// sdig pa spyod pa rnams la rgyud chad pa// 'byung snyam dga' rab dbang phyug bzhin ras zum// gzhan pa lnga brgya mtha' ma'i tsha gdung khrod// thar par bgrod pa'i lus rnams dgun dus kyi// kha ba'i reg byas bskus pa yang dang yang*// pad dkar tsan dan nags tshal gnas ring mod// 'dir gang bshad par bya na dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khros pa'i mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po de'o// tshul ji lta bus bshad na/ gleng bslang gleng gzhi bstan pa/ rgyud kyi gzhung rgyas pa nges par bstan pa/ le'u mtha' ma gsang ba bsdu ba'i tshul gsum gyis so// dang po ni de nas bcom ldan kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mngon par mkhyen pa yis// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'joms byed pa// bka' yi 'khor lo bshad par bya// zhes dgos pa dang nyid dgos gzigs nas bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ges dpal 'bras spungs rgyal ba'i mchod rten chen por bde mchog gi rgyud gzhan thams cad bshad pa'i mjug thogs su 'di'i gleng bslang bar mdzad la/ de yang bde mchog chen po las bsdus par yang bla ma rnams/

de'i sdom pa rgya mtsho'i mjug tu/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung nag po che// bya rog ming can tshogs kyi bdag /'khor ni nag po stong dang bcas// ma mo nag mo 'bum gyis bskor// de yi gsang ba sngags kyi gnad// rdo rje 'chang gis bka' stsal to// zhes sogs kyis shin tu rgyas par bshad yod ces gsungs la/ de rigs pa nyid de/ thugs rje 'byung bar/ bde mchog rgya mtshor bshad pa bzhin// ming dang le'u brjod bya don// phyi nang go rim gzhung gi tshad// de yi dbye ba rgyas zhes bstan// zhes pas so// de bzhin bde mchog gi rtsa ba'i rgyud nyung ngu'i le'u nyer bdun brgyad gnyis su/ rigs gcig la ni kun spyod pa// rnal 'byor spyod pa rab tu mchod// ces nas/ 'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa// bdud kun rab tu zhi bar byed// ces pa'i bar gyis gsungs pa de 'dis bshad pas 'di de'i bshad pa'i rgyud du bgrangs pa yin no// dpal ni gnyis su med pa yin la/ gang gnyis su med na/ rdo rje ni dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i shes rab dang*/ nag po ni 'gyur ba med pas snying rje'o// chen po ni de dag gnyis su med pa nyid dang po'i mgon po/ khros pa ni ma rig pa'i bslad pa can la snying rjes so// mgon po ni lam dus kyi ste/ des dri ma zlog par byed pa'i phyir ro// gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ces grags pa ste/ ming 'dis brjod bya don gyi rgyud gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum du phye ste bstan no// de brjod par byed pa'ang de nyid las gzhan ma yin te/ brjod bya brjod byed ro mnyam pa'i phyir ro// 'di'i dgos pa ni/ ye shes mngon par mkhyen pa yis// zhes pas bshad de/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i snying po ye shes kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs shes pa'o// nying dgos ni/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'joms byed pa// zhes pas te/

de shes pas bdud las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba yin no// 'brel ba ni zhar gyis 'thon la/ bka' yi 'khor lo ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' 'di rgyud dang 'tsham par go ba la byed de/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgra bshad bzhin no// yang de nas zhes pa'i skad dod/ a tha e waṃ du bsgyur nas bshad pas/ de gnyis med pa ma yin pa dang*/ rgyud thams cad kyi thog mar tshig de gnyis rang nges par smra dgos pa ma yin pa'ang don la ston pa'i phyir du'o// gleng gzhi ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis thogs pa med cing gdon mi za ba bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas zhes nas/ kla klo'i skad kyis sbas pa ste// zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyu'i rgyud dam gzhi/ de nas rkang pa lngas dbang*/ de nas drug gis lam gyi chings/ de nas bcu dgus bskyed rim/ de nas brgyad kyis gsang dbang gi lam/ de nas bzhis dbang gsum pa'i lam/ de nas bcu gnyis kyis dbang bzhi pa'i lam/ de nas gsum gyis dam tshig de nas bzhis brjod byed kyi rgyud kyi gnas pa/ de nas le'u dang po rdzogs pa'i bar gyis spyod pa mdor bstan pa yin no// 'di ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bshad par bzhed pa tsam ste tshig tu ma thon pas/ rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs dang mnyam pa de 'chad pa'i gleng gzhir song ngo*// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gsung rmi lam lta bu nye bar gsan te gsung rdo rje'i tshig 'di gsungs so// rdo rje 'dzin pa gang zhig gi /nas/ gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i// 'dod chags rdo rje'i skur ldan pa// zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyu'i ston pa longs skus/ rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bring po 'og min du rgyun mi 'chad par bskor ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbyangs dang mnyam pa de bshad pa'i gleng gzhi/

lho phyogs bya rkang ri dang ni// nas/ thub pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs// zhes pa'i bar gyis 'bras dus kyi he ru ka sprul pa'i skur bzhengs nas rgyud nyung ngu le'us bcings pa sh+lau ka bgrang bar nus pa rnams 'chad pa sku'i gleng gzhi ste/ 'di ni glegs bam la 'god par yang nus pa yin no// de la yang rgyas bsdus du ma ni gdul bya'i bsam pas yin la/ shin tu nyung ba'i bka' dag ni bdag cag lnga brgya mtha' ma pa rnams la dgongs nas so// mtha' ma 'di la gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni dpal 'bras spungs rgyal ba'i mchod rten dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus kyi seng ge'i khri ste/ lho phyogs bya rkang ri dang ni// dpal gyi ri la mdun phyogs pa// shrī dhā n+ya ka ṭa ka /pad+ma ge sar rgyas pa'i dbus// chos kyi 'byung gnas bstan par gnas// dpal ldan dga' ba'i khang pa brtsegs// gsang ba sngags kyi rgya mtsho yi// ma lus rgyal ba bgrod pa'i yul// gsang ba chos kyi dbyings chen po// dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor du// zhes dang*/ de dbus seng ge'i khrir bzhugs pa// zhes so/ 'khor ni/ kla klo'i yul gyi mi rnams dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs// lha dang lha min dri zar bcas// gsang chen yongs su rdzogs pa yi// rang byung ye shes pho brang du// tshangs dbang khyab 'jug dbang phyug dag /dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir bcug nas kyang*// skye bo chags can rab 'dul phyir// mchog tu gyur pa'i snying po gsungs// phyogs bcur gnas pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs// gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kyi// khrag khrig ri rab rdul mnyam dang*// zhes pa 'dis kla klo yul gyi mi ni sham+bha la yi rgyal po 'khor bcas so// ston pa ni/ thub pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs// rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la// zhes gsungs pa shākya seng ge nyid dpal mgon po thams cad 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs nas 'di bshad pa ste/

gzhan du/ gsang chen yongs su rdzogs pa yi// rang byung ye shes pho brang du// zhes gsungs pa 'brel med par 'gyur ba'i skyon mchi'o// zhu ba dang sdud pa po/ rdo rje snying po sems dpa' che// bla gos phrag pa gcig gzar te// pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs// thal mo sbyar te 'di don zhus// zhes sogs kyis so// chos ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ bla med sangs rgyas bstan pa la// dga' zhing mgu la rab dad pa'i// sems dpa' chen po gsang ba'i don// rab tu zhus pa legs so legs// shin tu rmad du byung ba yi// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul don du// byang chub sems kyi ye shes mdzod// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// zhes nas rgyud rdzogs pa'i bar ro// dus ni bcom ldan 'das dgung lo bdun cu rtsa dgu pa nag pa'i nya la'o/// / gnyis pa rgyud kyi gzhung rgyas pa nges par bstan pa la/ 'khrugs bsdebs nas rgyud kyi mngon rtogs bslang ba dang*/ le'us bcad pa'i gnad kyis rgyud cha shas su gsil ba rnam grangs su bstan pa'o// dang po la/ ji ltar zhus pa/ de la lan rim par btab pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsang chen khyad par 'phags pa yi// lhun gyis grub pa'i phyag rgya che// zhes pas dang po'i mgon po dris pa/ mi 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i lam// zhes pas lam dus kyi mgon po dris pa/ rgyu bstan pa/ de nyid ces pas 'bras bu'i dus kyi mgon po dri ba gsum ste/ mtshan dang gleng gzhi'i 'brel gyis bstan pa yin no// lam dus las 'phros nas/ dus dang gnas dang gang zag ste// spyod yul bstan pa'i khyad par ni// zhes pas dri ba bzhi ste/ dus nam/ gnas gang*/ gang zag ci lta bu/ rnal 'byor gyi spyod yul/ de las 'phros nas/ sgrub dang bsgrub pa 'phrin las tshogs// thabs dang stobs dang 'jug pa ste// mngon byed/ ces pa dris pas bdun no// gnyis pa de la lan rim par btab pa la/

gzhi dus kyi lan lam/ 'bras dus kyi lan bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ de la dngos grub thams cad kyi// grub pa rab tu ster byed pa// rgyal ba kun gyi snying po ste// snying po'i sgra ni bstan pa thams cad kyi gces shos la bzhag pa dang*/ dri ma dgu'i sbubs su gnas pa la bzhag pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma'o// de'i ngo bo ni/ ya ki ye shes kyi mgon po nas ma ki the'u rang rkang gcig pa'i bar tha dad med pas rgyud gcig ste/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin// zhes rgyan las gsungs pa'i phyir ro// rgyud gcig tu bzhag pa'i gnas skabs der yang dngos por gzung rgyu zhig tu ma grub pas rang bzhin med pa zhes bya/ de ka rang bzhin rnam dag gi don du bla ma bzhed la/ bzhed pa ltar rgyal ba rnams kyis 'di'i dper nam mkha' gzung ste/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med// khams gsum po ni ma lus pa// 'gro kun sgyu ma lta bu yin// lag pa la sogs pas myul ba'i tshe reg bya med pa tsam zhig la 'jig rten nam mkha' zhes zer la/ rgyu des gzhan gyi go mi dgag pas gzhan mi sgrib pa ste/ chos mngon par/ de la nam mkha' mi sgrib pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gang dngos po zhig tu grub na des der gzhan 'jug pa'i go bgags te pha bong lta bu'o// de'i phyir rang bzhin med pas rang bzhin can ltar snang ba 'di thams cad rkyen gyi ngor rung ba me long dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan bzhin no// de ltar shar ba de las gzhan du med kyang snang tsam zhig logs su grub pa 'dra bas sgyu ma lta bu ste/ brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi// 'gro ba dmigs su med pa ste// mthong ba dang ni thos pa sogs// thams cad sgyu ma lta bur 'char// zhes so// de'i phyir phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// 'byung ba bzhi la sogs pa rnams// thams cad gdod nas dag pa yis// ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs kyis// dngos po du ma gsal bar snang*// ye shes med par skye mi 'gyur// sangs rgyas ye shes kyis rab bskul/

nam mkha'i dpes mtshon pa'i gzhi de yang sangs rgyas kyi gzigs pa la bya yi/ bdag cag gis mthong ba ni bcos ma ste/ dper na skyes bu lha sbyin o tshom mer 'dug bzhin pa la dgra gnyen mchod sbyin gyis tha dad par mthong ba lta bu'o// de lta ba po'i skyon yin gyi/ lta gzhi'i de'i ma yin pa bzhin/ gzhi 'khrul med la 'khrul pa'i lhad glo bur du zhugs pa shes par bya'o// lhad des rkyen byas pas srid pa ji srid dman mchog gi snang ba 'jug la/ lhad de 'jug pa med par gyur na snang ba thams cad dag ste 'tshang rgya ba yin no// de'i phyir/ ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni// kun mkhyen bde gshegs bzhugs gyur pa// mya ngan 'da' bar mi mdzad cing*// de srid mtshungs med sems can don// rgyun mi 'chad par 'gro ba kun// srid pa'i zhags pas 'jigs med par// byams pa'i thugs kyi brtson 'grus kyis// rtag tu sems can don mdzad rnams// nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug par// smon lam rnam par sbyong byed cing*// snying rjes don brtson sems kyis ni// dpa' bos srid pa sbyong bar mdzad// sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu bzhin// de bas gzhi dus kyi snying rjes gzhan gyi go 'byed pa bzhin/ lam dus su sems can sdud par byed la/ 'bras dus su sems can thams cad kyi don 'char bas/ snying rje'i steng du gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad lhun gyis grub bo// de bzhin gzhi dus su rkyen ma zhugs pa rang bzhin gyis dag lam dus su 'khor ba sbyong la/ 'bras dus su dag pa gnyis ldan te/ blo zad chos zad du 'gyur bas/ stong pa'i steng du gzhi lam 'bras bu lhun gyis grub bo// de'i phyir/ gsang ba las kyi rim pa nyid// ces bstan no// gzhi la rkyen zhugs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bstan pa bsrung zhing bka' la mnyan// dam tshig 'dzin pa'i zhing skyong la// mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug gtso// dpal ldan zhing skyong thams cad las// mchog tu gyur pa'i las sgrub pa// dpal ldan nag po chen po ni// 'dus pa 'dis ni lha min gyi// g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa yin// zhes dang*/

'og tu/ dpal ldan lha mo chen mo dang*// nag mo re ma tir gyur pa// lcam dral gyur pas bstan pa bsrung*// zhes thugs dkyil ba thams cad yum can du bshad pa dang*/ zhing skyong ba/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gtso bo ste/ gzhan du sa gsum dbang byed pa'o// zhes dur khrod kyi zhing skyong brgyad/ 'di la dngos zin pho gtso bor gyur pa 'dra zhig bstan yang*/ rigs thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor la mo gtso dgos la/ le'u bcu gcig par/ de nas dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dur khrod gnas pa'i zhing skyong dang*// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing skyong bcas// de dag rim pa bshad par bya// rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya mo// drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 'phrin las dang*// 'di nyid gsang ba'i mgon po yi// thabs mchog 'di ni kun tu sbas// zhes bshad pas so// lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pa// mchod 'os gtso bor gyur pa yin// zhes sku dkyil gyi lha bshad nas/ sku dang gsung dang thugs gsang ba// sgo gsum sbrag dang*/ de yang lha'i dag pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ phyi nang de nyid kho na'i don// yon tan 'phrin las dbang phyug tu// dam tshig mgon po zhes gsungs so// de'i don/ de kho na nyid du chos nyid kun 'gro yin pas chos can du mar grub la/ des chos chos nyid mi phyed pa dang*/ gsang bar rigs gcig rigs brgya nas grangs med pa'i bar du 'char bas/ rigs dang rigs can mi phyed pa dang*/ ya gi dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nas ma gi the'u rang gi bar thams cad nang rtsa'i rten 'byung ste/ rtsa khams ma dag par de dag kyang bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa bar du gcod byed kyi bdud/ rang gi rtsa dag pa na de dag chos skyong du zhal bsgyur/ rtsa thams cad dbu mar thim na rang rgyud du dwangs te 'tshang rgya bas/ rje btsun gyis/ nang rtsa gzugs rten 'brel shes pa'i phyir// phyi 'khrul snang gi gdon la nga mi 'jigs/ zhes dang*/

dgyes rdor las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// ji ltar nang bzhin phyi de bzhin// zhes so// 'di ka'i le'u bzhi par/ dkyil 'khor lha 'di lus nyid yin// gzhan du lha dang dkyil 'khor ni// btsal yang rnyed par mi 'gyur zhes// 'dren pa dpa' bos rtag tu gsungs// zhes bshad do// gzhan yang sam pu ṭar/ he ru ka la sogs pa'i lha// rtsa gzugs mdzes par yang dag byung*// zhes bshad pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ nga las 'jig rten thams cad byung*// nga las gnas gsum po yang byung*// dang*/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga*// dang*/ bde mchog nyung ngu las/ yul phyogs gang na gnas gyur pa'i// rigs ngan kla klo yin na yang*// yul de yongs su btags pa ste// sems can yongs su gzung ba'i rgyur// de ru nga ni rtag tu gnas// zhes 'byung bas thams cad he ru ka'i rol mo/ de'i phyir/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid// gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad do// zhes kun spyod las bshad do// 'di lta bu'i gnad go nas lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms na des tha mal gyi snang ba zlog par nus la/ der lha'i snang ba bsgom rgyu zhig ston dgos pa yang*/ dang po nas mtshan ma med pa la 'jog mi nus pas/ spros pa la 'khrid nas spros med la 'jug par bya ba'o// de ltar yang brtag gnyis las/ spros pa rmi lam ltar byas na// spros pa nyid kyang spros med byed// ces gsungs pas so// gzhan phyi rol du lha dang 'dre zhig gzung*/ de gsol ba dang brdung bar zhen pa dag ni rdo rje theg par mi 'gyur te/ gang zag des sems tsam gyi lta ba yang ma snyegs pas so// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mdo sde rgyan du de'i grub mthar/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// zhes 'byung bas so// dbu ma par 'gyur ba la der/ de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// zhes 'byung zhing*/ 'dir phyi nang sbyar ba yang thams cad mnyam pa nyid du ston pa ste/

phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i spros pa nye bar zhi na zhi ba'i dbyings de la mnyam pa nyid ces bya yi/ spros pa zing nger bzhugs pa'i mnyam nyid ni ming tsam mo// rang bzhin med pa thams cad par 'char ba tsam phyag rgyas mtshon nus pas phyag mtshan de dag kyang thugs su bzhag go /de ltar thugs phyag rgya chen po bshad nas le'u bzhi par/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba las// drag po kun gyi srog gyur pa// yon tan 'phrin las dbang phyug gi /phyi nang gsang ba'i bdag po yin// 'di yang sngar gsung rdo rje tshig tu 'thon pa'i gleng gzhir/ rdo rje 'dzin pa gang zhig gi /sgyu ma brag ca'i gzugs brnyan ltar// yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas dag tu// dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa bsgrub// ces sgra brnyan lta bur sngags bzla ba de 'chad par bzhed pa yin la/ bla ma rnams 'dir srog bzhi'i tha snyad mdzad de/ de bzhin 'dir// gcig las du ma'i ngo bo can// 'jig rten pa dang ye shes che// mi 'gyur ba dang dgug pa dang*// las rnams byed pa'i grogs gyur pa'o// gsang sngags 'khor lo 'di dag ni/ bye brag rnal 'byor pas bshad bya// zhes dang srog gam mi 'gyur ba'i srog 'khrul srog gam gnas pa'i srog gdags srog gam ming srog 'di dgug srog 'dren srog gam srog sngags/ 'di las byed kyi srog dang po ni chos thams cad la snying por bzhugs pas/ hūm̐ la byed/ de ka sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las te ye shes lnga ldan du bshad pas stong chen yi ge lngar 'gyur ba la/ rdo rje bzhi la gnas pa'i cha// gter gyi bum pa kha khyer ldan// dus kyi rgyal po 'od gsal ba// chu 'dzin phyogs tsam phyed ldan gnyis// sgra dang sgra yis khyab pa ste// du ma ma yin gnas pa'i yul// zhes dgongs pa'i skad kyis gsungs so// stong chen yi ge lnga ni dbyangs thams cad la khyab pa yin la/ de las thig le stong pa yi ge drug tu 'gyur ba gsal byed thams cad pa ste/

dbyangs dang gsal byed kyis ma bsdus pa'i yi ge ni ma mchis so// 'dis yi ge hūm̐ dang srog thugs mi 'gyur ba gcig yin pas thams cad kyi sa bon du 'di bzhed do// spyi'i mi 'gyur ba'i srog e la bzhag pa stong pa nyed er 'chad pa'i dgongs pas yin la/ de yang rnam 'gyur gtso bor song bas 'khrul srog tu gzung ngo*// der rnam par ma gyur pa'i a lta bu ni ngag thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin la/ de dang 'dir hūm̐ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs la gnas pa'i gsang sngags ngo ma yin par khyad par med/ de gsung rdo rje'i sa bon du bzhag pa'i tshe ring por snang ba tsam/ de bzhin yi ge oṃ sku'i sa bon du byas pa yang shes par bya dgos/ de bas na dri med 'od la sogs par/ sku gsungs thugs kyi snying po 'di dag las/ a u ma gsum las oṃ sgrub pa dang*/ a aḥrnam bcad gsum las āḥdang*/ ha u mā gsum las hūm̐ bsgrub par mdzad pa'ang sku gsung thugs gcig pa mtshon pa'i phyir ro// gzhan mi 'gyur ba'i srog tri la byed pa ni dregs pa kho na'i dbang du byas so// gdags pa'i srog ni ming ngam ming gi thog ma ste/ ī shwa ra lta bu'i/ a bsdus pa dang*/ bdud la du/ gshin rje la ya/ gza' la ra/ klu la phuḥ btsan la tsa/ gnod sbyin la k+ṣa/ rgyal po la rā/ ma mo thams cad la ma'am bh+yo/ pho brgyud thams cad la ya bshad pa lta bu/ 'dren srog ni rang rang gi snying po ste/ de ltar lha las kyi 'gyur na de'i sngags kyang 'gyur bas mtha' gcig tu mi gzung ste skabs thob kyis shes par bya'o// de yang*/ snying po/ yang snying*/ 'phrin las kyi sngags gsum du phye/ de thams cad kyang khrag mtsho khol ma'i rgyud du/ snying dbus srog gnas mi shigs pa// rtse mor gyur pa kun bskyed gzhi// mtshan nas brjod pa thun mong ba// de ni bde ba ming tsam yin// gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa// myur du bskul ba las byed 'gyur// yang snying gsang chen rang dbang med// len zhing 'dzin pas don grub pa'o// 'phrin las skul byed drag sngags ni// brjod pas thog dang glang chen bzhin// gang gtang rgyug cing 'joms par byed// ces so// gzhan 'dir/

rtsa ba'i sngags ni srog yin te// gsung gi dngos grub snying po yin// nye ba'i snying po thugs bskul ba'o// ye shes sa bon mi shigs pa// dwangs ma'i gnas par de bshad do// zhes so// lar ya gi rgyal ba rigs lnga nas ma gi dmyal ba'i bar gyi srog gzugs thams cad rtsa gzugs dbyibs kyi yi ger snang zhing der rlung rgyu ba'i gdangs las de dang de'i yi ge dngos grub pa'o// de'i phyir rtsa gzugs de dag tu rlung gis thig le 'khrid pa na so so'i gnas sbyong 'char la/ rtsa gzugs de dag 'khrul 'khor dang dmigs pa rlung gnad kyis bshig na de las grol nas phyin chad de'i snang ba mi 'char ba yin no// de'i phyir/ dwangs snyigs las kyi rgyu 'bras kyis// gnas pa khyad par rten 'brel te// 'khrul dang 'khrul pa ma yin pas// khams gsum kun la dbang byed pas// 'jig rten las dang ye shes kyi// mgon po'i khyad par mngon du 'byung*// zhes gsungs la/ las kyi rnam smin rags pas 'khrul pa shas che/ des 'jig rten pa/ rnam smin gyi gzugs phra bas ye shes pa ste/ so so skye bo dang ma rig bag chags kyi sa pa'i khyad lta bu/ don rags pa nyid sbyangs pas phra bar 'gyur zhing*/ phra ba dag na sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum du gnas 'gyur bas so// gdags pa tha snyad khyab pa po// thun mong bar ni bstan pa yin// gdags pa'i srog rtsa gzugs bod la bod dang rgya la rgya'i yi ge'i gzugs su yod pas skad rigs bzhi yod pa nas skad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bar te/ gri gug brtsegs par/ sngags ni rtsa ba'i srog nang gnas// ā li kā li khong nas 'byung*// 'jug 'byin rgyan grogs rkyen gyis bsgyur// ming dang tshig dang yi ge'i tshogs// rab tu byed pa du mar 'gyur// zhes pas so// de'i phyir/ 'di dag las dang skye bo las// sgrib pa thun mong lha yi cha// dngos dang brgyud pas lung bstan pas// srog dang srog ma yin pa ste// zhes pa 'byung ba'i dbye ba phan tshun dgra gshed grogs btang snyoms par 'gyur ba bzhin/

sngags de dag kyang dgra grogs btang snyoms par gnas pa bshad la/ rgyu dang rkyen dang bskul ba yis// gsang sngags bzlas pa mngon par phye// zhes pa/ glegs bam du bkod pa tsam ma yin pa/ rgyu dang rkyen gyi ngor/ dgra dang sprad pa/ grogs dang bsdeb pa/ yi ge bsnan pa/ dug dbyung ba/ dkrug pa/ 'phrul du bskor ba rnams shes dgos pas/ khrag 'tsho khol mar/ de yi gsang sngags bstan pa yang*// gtor dang gril dang dkrug pa'i tshul// byin che tshan skyed mi bzlog phyir// spyi dang bye brag bzlas pa bya// zhes bshad pa dang*/ thugs rje 'byung bar/ rang gi rgyud rtsub khro ba na// ye shes bsnyen pas stod la mnan// 'khor dang nor la 'khren pa na// 'phreng ba'i sngags kyis mgo thog bgrang*// nor dang bsod nams chung ba na// gsang ba'i sngags la thun bzhir rbad// lha bzhi'i 'byin 'jug ma shes na// nag po gnad nas 'khrul mi 'gyur// zhes sogs rgyud rnams las du mas gsungs so// bzhi snying sbas pa'i rgyud du/ 'jug pa rang rang skabs kyi 'bod// 'byin pa 'thems kyis bskor la dbyung*// zhes dang*/ rang gnas dang ni bskor ba dang*// mi bskor ba dang mthar zad dang*/ tsheg drag bar du dgra ming 'jug /ces tshe zad las zad du sdebs pa yang bshad do// bskul ba ni rnam pa bzhis te/ brjod pa dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ brdar gyur pa dang*/ 'gog pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa bzhi'i rim pas so// de bas na sngags la gzhung ji lta ba dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gi dbye ba gnyis las/ thams cad du phyi ma gtso ba yin no// de ltar gsung phyag rgya chen por bshad nas/ le'u bcu drug par/ dpal ldan nag po chen po yi// bka' yi tshogs kyi 'khor gyur pa// 'di ni kun tu shes par bya// las kyi mgon po rnams dang ni// lha mo chen mo 'khor dang bcas// lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pa// pho nya mngag gzhug las byed pa// gzhan yang phyogs skyong bcu dang ni// klu chen brgyad dang lha chen brgyad// gza' chen brgyad dang rgyal chen bzhi// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*// gnod sbyin brgyad dang 'phrog ma bu// sha za dang ni ma mo dang*// 'jig rten pa dang dam tshig gnas// zhing skyong ma lus 'khor dang bcas// 'di dag las kun byed pa yi// 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcas pa// grub pa rab tu rtsol bar mdzad// lha dang lha min mi'am ci// lto 'phye grul bum srul po dang*// lus srul grib gnon skye mched sogs// nam mkha' lding dang sha za dang*// 'byung po ma lus 'dus pa kun// zhes pa'i lha mo chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa yan gyis thugs/

'jig rten pa dang dam tshig gnas// zhes sogs kyi rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi'i zhing skyong ma/ rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyis sgo ma bzhi/ lhag mas sku dkyil ba bshad la/ de yang chabs gcig tu bshad pas dkyil 'khor gcig yin pa shes par bya'o// sangs rgyas la mthong ba po gsum gyi dbye bas sku gsung du 'gyur ba bzhin// dpal nag po chen po yang yin la/ chos sku ni sangs rgyas nang phan tshun/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni byang chub sems dpa' sa chen po la bzhugs pa bdag gi ngor/ sprul pa'i sku ni/ mchog dang skye ba sprul pa'i sku'i dbang du byas pa gnyis te/ dang po/ spu gri klad gzer nag po dngos grub 'byung ba'i bka' brgyud du/ dang po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gang gi bsrungs na/ bdud kyi rgyal po dga' rab dbang phyug gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che ni bsnubs/ log 'dren gyi spyod pa dar du bcug nas yod pa la/ 'gro ba rigs drug mun pa'i nang na gnas pa las byang chub kyi myu gu skye mi srid pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dregs pa can rnams thul bar ma gyur nas/ dpal chen po rdo rje srin por sku sprul te/ nam mkha' 'brug gis bkang*/ bar snang glog gis bkang*/ sa gzhi me dpung dang khro chung gi ser bas bkang nas gdug pa can thams cad ni brgyal zhing myos par gyur nas/ dpa' bo chen po dbugs phyung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so// de nas dregs pa can rnams brgyal sangs pa las dregs pa'i gtso bo de rnams na re/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsol cig ji ltar gsungs pa'i bka' bzhin byed do zer zhes nas byang chub kyi sems la bkod do// bar du dpa' bo chen po bstan pa la dgongs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs pas/ de'i ngang nas chu'i chu bur gyi tshul du gyur te legs ldan chen po'i skur gyur nas zhes phyag bzhi pa bshad la/

mtha' mar dpa' bo chen po'i thugs kyi dkyil nas drag po tsha rab rngam pa'i 'od nag po gcig 'thon par gyur to// 'od zer des 'jig rten gyi khams lan gsum du dkrugs te/ slar dpa' bo chen po'i thugs khar thim mo// thim pa dang zhal ldeg pa'i ngang nas hūm̐ hūm̐phaṭ phaṭ ces rngam par bsgrags pas/ thugs ka nas mi'i lus la bya rog gi gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas na gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon na thod khrag zhal du brngub pa/ sku la gdug pa'i 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba/ rkang pa sa la brdabs pas thams cad rdul du rlog pa/ skad cig gis stong gsum rlag par mdzad pa/ log 'dren can rnams brgyal zhing khrag tu skyug pa/ drag po btsan dug srog gi spu gri/ dam nyams kyi srog gcod/ bka' yis bstan srungs/ ye shes kyi spyan can/ nag po chen po'i snying tig 'di 'thon par gyur to// 'thon pa dang 'jig rten gyi khams 'gul 'gul shig shig gyur te/ zhes pas las mgon bshad do// gzhan yang ston pa nyid der sprul te mgon po thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud dngos grub 'byung ba gsungs pas kyang shes so// gnyis pa ni/ thugs rje 'byung ba rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa drag po rnam par 'khrug pa zhes bya ba la/ sangs rgyas zhi ba'i 'od tog gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung nas/ de'i bstan pa la gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas su bdud kyi rgyal po dga' rab dbang phyug gis bdud kyi sprul pa dbang phyug chen po ma hā de wa dang*/ lha mo u ma de wī gnyis sprul nas/ de gnyis kyis kyang 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gnyis sprul nas/ de dag gis 'jig rten gyis khams kyi sems can rnams la gsod pa'i las kyis zad cing brlag par byas nas/ stongs pa la thug pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas zhi ba'i 'od kyis bdud bzhi po de dag btul yang ma thul bas/ dpal bde ba chen pos bdud 'dul ba'i cho 'phrul gyis lha mo u ma la dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs bcu gnyis kyis sbyor ba byas pa las/

de dag la bu rdo rje srin po rab tu 'jigs pa dag skyes par gyur to// de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yo ba'i 'phrul 'khor 'gul zhing ldeg par gyur pa las/ bdud dga' rab dbang phyug yid 'khrugs par gyur nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yo ba'i 'phrul 'khor la zhugs nas/ lha ma yin gyi dmag bsdus nas thog nam mkha' la me dang 'brug dang*/ drag po'i cho 'phrul chen po bcu drug gis srid pa gsum 'gul 'gul shig shig byed pa las/ de'i tshe rdo rje srin po rab tu khros pa las/ bdud kyi zhal bzhi nas drag po'i sku byung bas/ de 'dul ba la gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi sprul/ kho'i mig la dug bzhi yod pa las/ de 'dul ba la 'phrin las kyi phyag bzhi sprul zhing dug zhi ba'i rgyal po bzhi sprul/ skye mched drug las mkha' 'gro ma drug rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad las bka' sdod kyi mgon po brgyad/ rigs pa'i yan lag bcu las phyogs skyong bcu/ dbang gi bzhin 'dzum bcu drug las mgo brnyan bcu drug sku'i bkod pa bco brgyad las ging chen bco brgyad/ khros pa'i nga ro nyi shu rtsa gcig las pho bdud nyi shu rtsa gcig chags pa'i gar nyi shu rtsa brgyad las dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ spyan gyi 'gyur bzlog sum cu las dregs pa sum cu dang*/ 'phrin las kyi 'od phung bdun cu las dpal mgon bdun cu/ zhal gyi mdangs byad brgya las ro langs brgya/ spyan gyi 'gyur ldog stong las nag po stong*/ zhabs kyi stangs stabs khri las gnod sbyin khri/ dbang gi gar spyod 'bum las ma mo 'bum/ ba spu'i 'od zer bye ba las sha za bye ba sprul nas/ drag po 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan dmar mo'i lus la dbang byas nas stan du bting*/ lha chen yab yum 'khor du bkod/ 'khor tshogs gzhan thams cad dbang du bsdus nas bdud kyi dmag tshogs thams cad brlag par byas so// des na yab ni khrag 'thung chen po he ru ka yin la/

ma ni u ma de wī zhes bya ba de yin te/ de dag gnyis las rdo rje srin po skyes so// de nas rdo rje srin po des bdud thams cad dbang du bsdus te nyid kyi sku las sprul pa thams cad rang la rang thim par gyur to// de nyid kyang dpal he ru ka'i zhal la thim par gyur to// zhes gsungs pa'i gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi ni re ma ti bzhi dug zhi ba'i rgyal po bzhi ste sras mchog bzhi/ hūm̐ mdzad/ myur mdzad/ gdong bzhi/ las mgon/ phyi ma las las mgon chen po gsum/ bka' sdod brgyad ni mgon po bka' brgyad du bshad do// yang der/ dang po sngon byung 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe// bskal pa bzang rgyan zhes ni bya ba la// sangs rgyas zhi ba 'od ces 'jig rten byung*// de la 'khor ni bye ba dung 'phyur 'bum// dge slong dge bsnyen tshangs spyod gtsang*// sbyangs pa bcu gnyis spyod pa las// byang phyogs o ṭa'i yul du song*// sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// sdig spyod rgyal po dga' ba'i dpal// khams gsum lha yi bdag po des// 'og gi rgya mtsho dug ri'i kha// dug gsum 'bar ba'i khang par bcug /bdud rgyal dga' rab dbang phyug dang*// btsun mo pad+ma'i 'phreng ba can// rang gi lha ru smon pa las// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul mkha' la gshegs// de tshe 'khor gyis smon lam btab// bdag cag dge slong pho mo rnams// tshangs spyod bsod nams sngags mthu yis// skye ba 'di nas gnyis pa na// srid pa gsum la dbang che ba// gnod sbyin gdug pa srin po'i rigs// sha za khrag 'thung srog gi bdag /las kyi gshin rjer smon lam gdab// smon lam bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ri rab ri yi rtse mo ru// lha chen dbang phyug chen po dang*// btsun mo u ma de wī la// bu ni brgyad skyes lha chen brgyad// de yi chung shos mgon po ste// srin po nag po stobs po che// sha dang khrag la rab dga' ba// srid pa gsum la dbang che ba// 'jig rten gsum po za byed cing*// khams gsum po ni brlag par byas// rgyal chen bzhi po bsgral byas nas// gsang ba'i yum bzhi nyid la sbyor// de la gsang ba'i bu bzhi skyes// srin po'i gzugs la bya rog gdong*// gsus khyim che la sha khrag dga'// mig rtsa dmar la mche ba ring*// drag po'i gzugs can bzhi ru byung*// steng phyogs tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas// lha mo brgyad po dbang du bsdus// 'dod khams lha rigs gnas drug nas// mkha' 'gro drug po dbang du bsdus// ri rab ri yi khong seng nas// lha srin sde brgyad dbang du bsdus// rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang nas// phyogs skyong bcu po dbang du bsdus// zhes dang*/

de nas srin po nag po des// sngon gyi smon lam dmod bor bas// las kyi skye dran dug ri'i khar// rgyal po 'khor bcas stong gi ni// mkhal ma snying dang nang rol dang*// lus phyed dag ni bcad cing zos// srin po laṅkā spu gri'i yul// srin gyi grong khyer bdun 'bum brlag /g.yas pa gcod byed gri gug gis// srin po'i mgo bcad don snying gtubs// laṅkā spu gri'i snying khrag 'thungs// lha min bu mo glog ma sprin// bsad nas mgo bcad 'phreng ba byas// zhes pa'i skye brgyud 'di ni las kyi mgon po'i yin la/ 'dir bya rog gdong bzhi ni/ bzhi snying sbas pa srog gzer nag por bshad pa'i/ srog bdag gshin rje bdud po/ gnod sbyin byar gdong bzhi'o// gzhan du bdud mo byar gdong yang bshad do// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nyid la 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i skye brgyud/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dgos 'dod 'byung ba las/ pha ni dga' rab dbang phyug yin// ma ni dur khrod pe tā li// bu ni nag po chen po ste// phas byin g.yas na gri gug ste// mas byin g.yon na thod khrag 'dzin// gzhan yang 'khor gyis byin pa ni// ral gri dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// mar me mdzad la sems bskyed nas// de bzhin gshegs par lung bstan pa// mi brjid 'jig rten khams gsum ni// sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'byung*// de yi bstan pa khyod kyis bsrungs// mu stegs gnod pa khyod kyis thul// zhes pas bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan srung mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas te bshad do// bskal ba bzang po yang*/ yar gyi ya thog ring mo/ bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad/ mar gyi ma thog ring mo zhes pa 'di tsam nyan thos dang lung cha mthun phal la grags/ dri med 'od du/ rnam par gzigs la sogs pa'ang bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas su bshad pa bzhin so thar mdo'i 'grel pa mang por bshad do// zhing khams 'di kha yang*/

bskal bzang gi mdor/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig nas bgrangs pa'i bcu dang bzhi bcu pa la sogs par zhing khams rgyal ba'i smon lam gyis 'gyur nas ches phun sum tshogs par bshad pas na/ ji skad bshad kyang mi 'gal ba'i gnad cig ma rig na rgyal ba'i bka' nang phan tshun mi mthun par 'gyur ro// de lta bu'i las kyi mgon po de yang*/ thugs rje 'byung ba'i rgyud du/ khyod ni dang po dus kyi sngon rol tshe// bram ze'i bu ni bla mar skyes pa'i tshe// gnod sbyin 'brog gnas bzang po la// gdug pa'i sems kyis nor bu brkus// 'gyod pa'i sems kyis slar gtad pa// mi 'dod tshur la sbyin par gtang*// mngon sum sangs rgyas la dad de// 'bras bu mi bslu sngon yang bskal pa brgyar// re re la yang bsod nams bsags las skyes// rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bas// bram ze'i sngags 'grub 'di nyid du// las kyi mgon po'i lus blangs nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bstan pa gtsug lag bsrungs nas kyang*// nub phyogs thal ba can zhes pa'i// rnam par dag pa'i 'jig rten der// khyod ni thal ba'i dbang po mchog /bde bar gshegs par sangs rgyas nas// lus can khyod kyis bsad pa rnams// zhing der thams cad sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes 'byung ba dang*/ kha tan+t+ra'i rgyud las/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras nyid las ma hā kā la bya rog gi rdo rje can du sprul nas kyang bshad de/ don la 'dul byed kyi ngor de dang der song bas gcig du mar song ba zhes bya'o// gri gug brtsegs par/ ye shes mgon po sa bcu yi// dbang phyug /ces dang*/ las mgon dur khrod bdag po ni// 'jig rten gnas pa sa drug pa// zhes bshad do// de bas na/ skye brgyud bshad par yang*/ chos skyong thams cad mgon po phyag bzhi pa nyid kyi sprul par bstan no// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nyid kyang don gsang ba sngags kyi ngo bo// brda thabs su der snang ba tsam ste// thugs rje 'byung ba rtsa ba'i rgyud du// zhal gcig chos sku mi 'gyur dag

/phyag bzhi 'phrin las bzhi mdzad pa// bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad gri gug dang*// lha min g.yul zlog ral gri g.yas// khams gsum dbang sdud thod khrag dang*// bgegs chen 'dul byed kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon// thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i// khros pa'i zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo// 'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel// dam tshig nyams pa'i snying khrag 'thung*// zhes dang*/ nam mkha' mnyam pa dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rgyud du/ gri gug nyon mongs gcod par byed// thod pa stong nyid don dam pa// shes rab ral gris mtshon pa ste// kha ṭ+wāṃ sku gsum ngo bo gcig /khyed kyis de ltar bstan pa ste// spyan gsum dus gsum mkhyen pa las// snying rje che bas spyan rtsa dmar// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bos te// phyag bzhi 'phrin las bzhi la sogs// mu stegs 'dul phyir ha ha brjod// 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig po// 'joms phyir thod rlon 'phreng ba can// dbul ba sel phyir sgeg pa ste// ye shes lnga po thod skam mtshon// stag lpags mnabs pas dpa' bo ste// mche bzhi skye gnas 'joms pa po// dri mas ma gos chu skyes gdan// rtag chad spangs pa dregs pa'i gdan// bdud dang mu stegs la sogs pa// thams cad 'joms phyir me dpung ngo*// zhes bshad/ yum chen gsum ni/ dag pa'i chos kyi sprul pa ni// phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin// zhes kun spyod las bshad pa ltar du/ 'khyud byed bde ba chen po ni dpal nag po chen po yin pas/ gri gug brtsegs par/ 'gro don snying rjes byed pa na// sgrol byed nag po chen por bshad// ces 'byung bas so// de la 'khyud pas stong nyid yum du grub la/ de yang rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi dbye bas dbyings yum sbyor yum sgrol yum gsum bshad/ rigs bzhi'i dbye bas re ma ti bzhi ste/ gsang ba'i yum chen ma bdun zhes bya'o// hūm̐ mdzad nag po chen po ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rdo rjes sprul pas lag na rdo rje/

myur mdzad nag po phyag drug pa ni gsung rdo rje 'jig rten dbang phyug gdong bzhi pa ni sku rdo rje 'jam dpal te/ phyi ma dngos grub 'byung bar sngags tsam las lha sbas te ma bshad pas gsang ba'i mgon po zhes bya'o// de dag rigs gsum gyi khro bo'o// mngon 'byung gi rgyud las sbas pa de phyung nas/ phyag bzhi pa bdud 'joms pa dang*/ hūm̐ mdzad dgra 'dul ba dang*/ phyag drug pa bgegs 'dul ba dang*/ zhal bzhi pa bstan pa skyong bar bsngags so// dpal las kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs las gdong can gsum ste/ don 'jig rten las las grub pa'i tshe bdag srog bdag 'chi bdag go /hūm̐ mdzad nag po chen po dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i thugs ka nas spros par rdo rje gur gyi rgyud nas bshad pas gur mgon zhes grags la/ de nyid kyis yang rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍī 'dzin pa 'di sprul par de kha'i rgyud las bshad/ legs ldan ljang sngon zhal gsum phyag drug pa nyid 'phrin las mdzad pa'i tshe/ yon tan mgon po 'dir bzhengs par yang de kha'i rgyud las bshad pa sogs/ don gcig la rnam 'phrul gyis gnyis 'dir 'god pa yang lag na rdo rje dang rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'dug sa gcig tu gral la bsgrigs pa lta bu'o// de bas dngos grub 'byung bar dngos su dkyil 'khor la mgon po 'di gsum 'god pa sbas kyang*/ le'u bcu bzhi par/ dkyil 'khor ba'i mgon po dang*/ yum dang bcas pa'i gsang sngags dang 'phrin las kyi le'u zhes gsungs shing der 'di dag gi sngags bstan pas shes par bya dgos pa dang*/ le'u bcu bdun par shar du sku yi mgon po dang*/ lhor yon tan mgon po dang*/ nub tu gsung gi mgon po dang*/ byang du las kyi mgon po ste/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ gri gug thod pa bsnams pa'o// so so'i g.yon du yum re re// gtum pa ma dang drag mo dang*// zlog byed ma dang dpa' mo ste// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan dang bcas// de yi phyi yi gru chad la// beng 'dzin pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

/gaṇ+ḍī 'dzin dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin// so so yum dang bcas pa ste// de yi phyi yi sgo dang grwar// lha mo brgyad po gar gyis rol// thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// gar stabs ldan par bzhugs pa'o// zhes gsungs la/ 'khor tshogs 'di thams cad kyi mi gsal ba bshad pa'i rgyud kyis kha bskang dgos pas/ khrag mtsho khol mar/ ye shes kyi mgon po ni gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ri mā la ya'i rtse mo'i gzhal yas khang na gnas so// gsod byed sku'i mgon po bsil ba'i tshal na gnas pa'o// rngam byed gsung gi mgon po gyad kyi yul na gnas pa'o// sgrol byed thugs kyi mgon po u rgyan na gnas pa'o// mi'u thung khros pa srin po'i gling ste/ de'i 'khor las kyi gshan dmar ni kar+ṇa pa'i yul gyi rlung spu gri can gyi gnas su'o// phyag drug pa dpal gyi ri'i 'gram na'o// gri gug brtsegs pa ni ha ri ke lar ro// chu srin la zhon pa'i mgon po dpal skyong drag po ni rdo rje gdan gyi bka' bsrung ngo*// gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po ni siṅgā la na gnas so// beng 'dzin pa ni gdong dmar gyi brag la brten pa'o// beng 'dzin pa bar pa ni rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la'o// zhes so// 'dir bshad pa'i dpal ye shes mgon po ni legs ldan/ gsod byed sogs gsum byar gdong*/ mi'u thung khros pa ma ning*/ mgon po beng gdong dmar gyi brag ste skyi shod kyi mgon po gdong ngo*// 'di brag lha mgon po yang btags/ spyir gdong dmar zhes pa rgya nag la'ang bzhag kyang 'dir bod do// dpal skyong drag po nag po chen po 'bar ba ste rdo rje gdan gyi lho'i sgo skyong du bshad pas so// beng 'dzin bar pa ni a gho ra'o// stag zhon ni der ma hā kā la stag la gnas pa dang*/ zhes gsungs la/ gnas sa de'i gzhung du lcang lo can dang gyad yul na'o// trag shad ni rdo rje bse gdong ste rgya nag ge'u te shan gnas la/

gzhan du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gang du gnas pa der ro// de nyid du/ chos skyong chen po de dag ni bstan pa 'dzin pa'i sgrub pa po gang du gnas par 'du zhing las thams cad grub par byed do// zhes bshad pas/ chos skyong du ma bsten na khu bzlog 'byung snyam pa'i log rtog kyang zhar la bkag go /re ma ti bzhi la 'dir 'phrog ma la sogs pa'i mtshan bstan pa bzhin me kha la zhes bya ba'i gzungs sngags las kyang bshad pa ni mthun la/ de bya ba'i rgyud kyi lngas rtsen gyi rigs su gsungs la/ 'dir rdo rje rigs kyi yum du bshad pa ni gdul bya'i skal bas so zhes mang du smras so// zhing skyong la/ kun tu gtum pa'i shugs 'chang ba// yul dang yul du rol byed pas// shing rnams la ni gnas nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor zhing rnams skyong bar byed// dur khrod gnas kyis yongs su bskor// ma mo gnas sogs khyab par byed// klu yis mtshon pa'i zhing skyong la// me yis phye bas yongs su bskor// sgor ni mig gis khyab par 'gyur// zhes pa/ rdo rje pho nya mo brgyad la/ dur khrod kyi ma mo bzhi bzhis bskor bas bzhi bcu phyogs mtshams brgyad la mes phye bas nyer bzhi'i yul gyi zhing skyong ma rnams la pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi phan gnod kyi las byed pa gsungs pa dag go /de dag gi gtso mo yab yum dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi dur khrod du 'byung ba'i zhing skyong yin pa dang*/ 'khyud byed so gnyis/ sgor mig ces pa lcam dral gyi zhing skyong bzhi'o// sde brgyad la/ lha chen po lha'i mgon po'am ma mo'i sde dpon te/ dur khrod kyi ma mo thams cad kyis mchod pa'i yul yin pas dang khams gsum gyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir ro// de bas na 'di la phyi'i sde brgyad 'khor du 'gyur ro// dpal bdud kyi mgon po ni 'jig rten pa'i skye brgyud dang bstun na bdud rgyal nag po bkrag med ces bya ba bdud yul kha rag mgo dgu'i gling na gnas pa ste/

don sha za seng gdong*/ 'di yang thub dka' zhes bod yul gyi zhing skyong chen po de ka yin la/ bdud yul kha rag ces pa'ang bod bdud kyi gzung ba de'i dus kyi rgyal khams kyi ming de ltar grags pa'o// 'on kyang sgo skyong ma dag dang 'di lta bu la sogs pa bya ba'i dbye bas gnyis gnyis 'dir dkyil 'khor du bzhugs so// 'di la srid pa gsum sgrol ba'i las byed pas bdud/ de'i phyir las byed kyi sde brgyad thams cad 'khor ro// gshin rje ni phyogs skyong dang don gcig 'on kyang 'chi med mdzod la sogs bar chos kyi rgyal po bdun bshad/ gzhan gshin rje'i sde dpon brgyad/ gshin rje pho nya mo sogs ma mo brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa/ gshin bu'i rje yin pas gshin rje'o// de ni sngags kyi bdag por bshad pas sngags kyi sde brgyad thams cad 'khor ro// gza' ni nang du mun can/ phyi'i sgra gcan lha ma yin gyi sde dpon kyang yin la/ chos mngon pa'i gzhung las/ de dag gi gtso bo mchog rab ni thag bzang ris la bshad kyang*/ 'chi bdag bdud po dngos su rgyu ba rā hu la/ 'dis ki kaṃ du bzhag pa dang*/ zhib mor brtags na 'char ka nag po yang 'di ka'o zhes bla ma gsung ngo*// 'jig rten khams na drag shul che la/ de nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed pos 'khor lo 'phangs pas lus dum bu brgyad du song ba lha chen gza' brgyad/ don de ka bsdongs zlas phye ba'o// phyi rol gyi res gza' dag kyang don de dag rnam pa so so/ gza' dgur byed pa'i mjug ris kyang 'dis mjug mar bsdu la/ shin tu myur par las byed pas myur mgyogs kyi sde brgyad do// klu bdud nag po mgo dgu pa zhes mgon po'i lung mang por bshad pa ni/ gdug pa can klu'i nang na de las mthu rtsal che ba med pas klu'i bdud dam/ klu'i srin po yin pas nā ga rāk+ṣa zhes bshad de/ gtad khram rus sbal nag po'am/ gshin rje 'khor lo nag por bshad pa dang*/

yi dam ltar bsnyen pa'i tshul mang por gsang sngags rnying ma las byung zhing*/ 'di'i klu brgyad kyi srog bdag lha 'dre brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa rnam 'gyur du byed pas rnam 'gyur de sbas pa'i phyir sbas pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad 'khor ro/ beg rtse ni btsan gyi sde dpon/ btsan zhes pa'ang gsung rab chen po dag tu sha za'i sgras bsnyad pa kyang ngo*// de dag kyang nang gi lha ma srin sde brgyad de/ sha zar mtshan mo rgyu ba thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir ro// gnod sbyin nag po khrag ral can zhes gsungs shing*/ skabs 'gar gnod sbyin byar gdong du yang bshad pa ni zhang 'on/ phyis rig 'dzin rnams kyis ban chen rdo rje bdud 'dul du mtshan btags/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i sras te gnod sbyin brgyad ni/ gsang ba'i sde brgyad de/ dregs pa thams cad kyang gnod sbyin du bsdus dus kyi sde dpon yin pas so// rgyal po pe hā ra ni ging chen po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gur gyi mgon po dang rgyud gcig tu gsungs pa zhes grags pa/ 'di'i 'khor pu tra bha dra sring mo/ gnod sbyin yab yum rnams sa lugs pa'i gur kyi 'khor du byung ba de ka yin zhing*/ ru 'dren sde bzhi'ang de ka'o// de bas btags chags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad ces/ mkha' la rgyu ba'i tshogs thams cad do// 'dir sde brgyad bsdu ba'i mtshan nyid srid pa'i gter khyim sogs dang mthun la/ mtshan gzhi ni ma nges te/ phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po gang du'ang 'dren pa bzhin no// phyogs bcu skyong ba ni nges par sla la/ rgyal po chen po bzhi bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gi blon po bzhi yod pa'i gshed chen por rgyal bas bskos pa'o// de'i phyir thugs rje 'byung bar/ rgyal chen bzhi bsad ces pa snga ma bdud kyi blon po bzhi po de yin pas shan phyed par bya'o// de bas na dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir dpal gyi mgon po lcam dral nas srid pa pho rgyud mo rgyud ci yang ma 'tshogs pa med do// 'di la bos na mi khom pa'i mgron med de/

'dir ni snang srid thams cad dkyil 'khor chen por bsgyur bas so// de lta bu'i thugs dkyil du lha dgod khyer/ thugs rje 'byung bar yang*/ yi ge hūm̐ las byung ba ste// nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng du// sa bcu'i mgon po ye shes pa// brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs par bsgom// 'jig rten las sprul yum chen gsum// dkar dmar nag po khros pa'i sku// 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bzung*// yi ge k+ṣaṃ las bskyed par bya// thugs kyi sras mchog chen po bzhi// sprul pa'i mgo brnyan byar gdong bzhi// hūm̐ las skyes pa'i nag po che// nas// rigs bzhi 'khor dang bcas par bsgom// skye mched sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro drug /ye shes las dbang dbang mo che// 'byung ba drug las byung ba yi// dang*/ las kyi bka' sdod yab yum brgyad// dha dang dhe las byung ba'i sku// 'jigs pa'i zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs// lag na beng mdung glo snying za// dar nag 'jol ber lus la gyon// sprul pa mgo brnyan spyi bor brtsigs// mi mgo'i 'phreng ba lus la 'chang*// bdud 'dul mi ro'i steng na bzhugs// lha mo mgyogs ma mgo brnyan can// gri gug thod pa lag na thogs// mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs can// sku mdog nag mo mun pa'i gzugs// phyogs dang mtshams na gnas par bsgom// zhes bshad pas/ 'dir lha grangs ji ltar bshad pa der gtan la phab la kha dog phyag mtshan gyi khyad par cung zad snang ngo*// de lta bur/ gri gug brtsegs pa'i rgyud du yang*// khyad par lha mo lcam mo ni// bong bu gwa dmar chibs pa ste// las byed srin mo'i tshogs bcas pa'o// ming po mgon po nag po ni// phyag bzhi pa dang phyag gnyis pa// nag po du ma'i gtso bor gyur// gtum byed nag mo ma mor bcas// phyogs mtshams gnas pa'i lha mo dang*// 'jigs byed drag mo rngam dang rgod// las mkhan khwa ta'i gdong can dang*// pho nya'i mgon po sha za brgyad// so so'i sde dpung bcas pa ni// 'di dag gis ni sngon dus su// de bzhin gshegs pa du ma mchod// da lta phyogs bcu'i zhing khams skyong*// thub pa chen po 'di yi ni// bstan pa srung bar byed pa yin// ma 'ongs pa na'ang de bzhin 'gyur// zhes so// 'dir bya rog gdong sde brgyad mgon po'i sngon du bshad pa ni/

las grub kyi dkyil 'khor la de gtso bor bstan pa yin no// de phyir phyag gnyis pa gtso bor gyur pa de'o// de lta bu'i ye shes kyi mgon po la/ bya rog ming can zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ bdud dpung thams cad 'joms byed pa'i// mgon po bya rog can zhes pa// sngon tshe lha min 'dul ba'i tshe// bya rog dag tu sprul nas ni// de yi yang sprul du ma yis// 'od zer nag po skar mda' stong*// de yis bdud tshogs pham pa byas// srin po'i tshogs ni 'dul ba'i tshe// bya rog chen pos gshog pa brdabs// de tshe rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa dang*// me dpung kha nas spros pa yis// thams cad bsregs shing rdul du brlags// gshin rje'i yul du bya rog ches// tog tog rngam pa'i sgra bsgrags pas// be ta sa sta btul bar gyur// ma mo rnams ni dbang du byas// bdud kyi dpung rnams ka ni kar// g.yos tshe sum cu rtsa gsum nas// bya rog chen po khros pa yis// lha dmag dung phyur phrag brgya rnams// gshog pa'i steng du bteg nas ni// 'ongs te bdud tshogs pham par byas// dus gsum ma lus thams cad du// kun khyab glog gi 'od ltar 'khyug /thams cad mthong ba rdo rje yis// mngon shes mnga' bar 'gyur ba'i gnad// rdo rje bya rog can du grags// sgrub pa po rnams skyong ba'i tshe// bya rog chen pos srung bar byed// nye ba'i yul ni nyi shu bzhi// khyab mdzad zhing skyong chen po ste// ljon pa'i shing la brten te gnas// de phyir zhing skyong chen por grags// thabs dang shes rab shes par ldan// rdo rje'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzad cing*// gnam lcags 'bar ba rdo rje'i mchus// khro zhal can dang phyag zhabs la// bya sder sen mo rnon po can// las kyi mgon por rab tu grags// kaṃ ka bya khyung khwa ta 'gyed// ye shes sems dpas ma thul ba// ma rungs gdul dka' des 'dul bas// bya rog gdong can drag po che// zhes rgyu mtshan bdun gyis gsungs so// las kyi mgon po rdo rje'i gshog pa can dang zhing skyong rnams sprul par yang 'dis bstan no// de bas na 'di'i srog gi snying por/

kā wu wa wa pa shā ya zhes pa nyid rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin gyi/ kā wu wa wa pu ṣa ya zhes 'don pa ni mkhas 'dod can dag gi bcos ma'o// snga ma bya rog ming can/ phyi ma bya rog sku can zhes bsgyur bas khyad par med do zhes smra ba'i 'gal spong yang rgyu mtshan 'dis mi 'thad do// de bas gshis gang du yang ma grub/ gdangs lha'i rol mor gnas pa'i gnad shes na sku phyag rgya chen por 'gyur bas/ brtag gnyis las/ sgom pa po med sgom pa med// lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin// spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// zhes gsungs so// de phyir phyag rgya chen po gsum po'i lan ni rdzogs rim mtshan nyid gsum ldan du ston pa ste/ rnam par mi rtog pas zab pa/ rnam pa thams cad pas gsal ba'am rgya che ba/ lhan cig skyes pas zung 'jug ste/ gcig dang du ma ro mnyam pa'o// 'dir rdzogs rim dang por ston pa'ang*/ 'chad 'gyur thams cad lta ba'i rtsis zin na thar pa'i thabs su 'gyur gyi/ ma zin na 'khor ba kho na'i rgyu nyid red pa/ de'i phyir slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i gzhung las kyang*/ lta ba gyabs kyi lha zhes rnam pa kun tu gces par gzung la/ jo bo rjes kyang*/ sangs rgyas pa yi sngags rgyud dang*// mu stegs pa yi sngags rgyud la// stong pa nyid la khyad par yod// ces gsungs shing*/ de bzhin 'di kha'i gleng gzhir/ shes rab snying rje zung 'jug pa'i// ting 'dzin gang du sgom byed pa// bla med dkon mchog gsum pa ste// rgol ba ngan pa bzlog par mdzad// thub pa mchog gi bstan pa la// 'dzin dang skyong dang bsrung ba gsum// lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la// bdag tu 'dzin pa spong bar mdzad// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan par// ye shes gcig pu bsgrub par bya// zhes gsungs pas so// de bas na 'dir lha'i dag pa yang*/ dam tshig gsang ba 'byung ba las// rgyal ba rin chen 'bar ba'i gtso// phyogs dus med par rang byung ba// dam tshig gsang ba 'byung ba ni// mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen/

rgyal ba rin chen 'bar ba'i gtso ni de las yid bzhin gyi nor bu'am dpag bsam gyi shing rnam par rtog pa'am 'bad rtsol med par 'dod dgu ster ba lta bur/ phyogs dus med par rang byung ba'i lha'i rol pa spros pa dang bral ba las snang ba de/ chos 'byung pho brang dkyil 'khor du// chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas so// de nyid dkyil 'khor te/ snying po len pas so// rigs kyi yon tan ldan par yang*/ len bya'i snying po de yang*/ rigs lnga drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang mi phyed pa'o// gang de dag dang mi phyed na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshogs 'di pa'o// ji ltar mi phyed pa ni/ 'dus par/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lnga ru rab tu grags// zhes sogs kyis gsungs pa ltar ro// de'i phyir gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ro mnyam pas/ nam mkha' rgya mtsho 'bras ldan pa// phun sum tshogs pa lhun gyis grub// ces bshad do// gzhal yas khang gi dag pa ni// mi phyed lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyal// pho brang gsang ba'i gzhal yas khang*// mi phyed pa ni gnyis su med pa gang gnyis su med na rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ brten pa lha gnyis su med pa zhes bya'o// de bas gzhal yas khang gis rnam byang gi chos thams cad bstan la/ lhag par dpal bde mchog bla ma las de ka rigs lngar bshad pas so/// / gnyis pa lam dus kyi lan la spyir btab pa dang*/ bye brag phye ste btab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba// de nyid bla med sgrub pa po// bla na med pa ni sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin rdo rje theg pa'o// bsgrub bya der/ 'bras bu lam du byed pas sbyor ba ste/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed pa// snying po 'bras bu lam byed pa// zhes so// su zhig der sbyor na/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung ba yi// sems can sdug bsngal gzigs nas ni// zhes pa dag go

/tshul ji lta bus sbyor na/ so so'i mos pa la bkri ba'i sgo nas te/ ji lta ji ltar grol gyur pa// de lta de yis grol bar mdzad// de'i phyir gdul bya dang por khrid pa'i sgo ni rab tu mang bas rim pa gcig gis gzhal bar mi nus/ des theg pa sna tshogs te/ mi dang*/ lha dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'o// sgo sna tshogs pa nas zhugs kyang thar pa'am de kho na nyid du bgrod ka ma'i lam ni gcig ste/ de kho na nyid gcig yin/ de mthong ba'i ye shes kyang gcig pur zad pas so// de'i phyir/ theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis// 'gro ba'i don la rtogs pa po// zhes der/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la// theg pa gcig gis 'bras bur gnas// zhes mtshan yang dag par brjod par gsungs so// bgrod pa'i lam gcig pu ka rnal ma'i lam/ gang la bcos bslad ma byas na des rang bzhin shes par nus pa/ dper na chu rnyog ma can ma bsgul bar bzhag na rang dwangs pa bzhin no// de'i phyir bla ma rnams ma bcos so mar gzhog shes na/ ma yengs pa dang des rnal ma'i lam du zhugs pa zhes gsungs nas/ de slob mas ci shes mdzad/ de shes na spang bya spang du med pa dang gnyen po bsten du med de srid zhi ngang gis mnyam nyid du shes/ de la rang bzhin yongs shes kyi tha snyad mdzad/ de 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs ngo mar song nas/ bka' brgyud 'di'i ring lugs phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes pa bye ba khrag khrig zhig byung ba ni mngon sum pa'o// gzhan gzhog khyer de la 'khu ba ni yul snang dgrar gzung de bshig par 'dod/ lung rigs kyi bsam gzhigs mang po mdzad pas mthar 'o brgyal/ mig 'bras gting du lhung*/ sngo lhang nge ba/ sems can dmyal ba bzhin du dran pa shin tu gsal nas/ tshe gzhug sdug dogs srid pa'i srad bu skyed gang thub byed pa kho nar mthong ngo*/// /

gnyis pa la dus kyi dris lan/ gang zag gi gnas kyi spyod yul bstan pa'i khyad par gyis lan bzhi/ dang po ni/ dus ni bskal pa bzang po yi// rdzogs ldan mtha' mar gyur pa yi// dpag med dus las 'das na ni// gsum ldan dang ni gnyis ldan nas// rtsod pa'i dus kyi rim pa la// bcom ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus// de yi bstan pa'i snyigs ma yi// lnga brgya pa yi dus kyi mthar// shin tu gdug cing rtsub pa yi// mi bsrun pa yi dus kyi tshe// de tshe mgon po'i bstan pa 'byung*// de yang*/ las kyi sa pa'i bskal par gyur pa dang*/ khyad par snyigs ma las ches snyigs ma lnga brgya mtha' ma la nye ba da lta'i dus la 'di dag nyon mongs pa rags pas de spangs nas sems rtse gcig pa la 'jog mi nus pa dang*/ ser sna dang g.yo sgyu'i dbang du song ba'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa dang du len dka' ba dang*/ rgyud sde phyi ma dag bzhin du/ bya ba dang rnal 'byor rgya chen po snyugs kyis mi khyongs pa dag la/ gti mug dang*/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang ngam/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spang mi dgos/ de kho na'i sgor zhugs nas tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i gseb lam bla na med pa'i rgyud gsal bar bstan la/ de yang bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung ba gsum las/ phyi ma gtso bor gyur pa ni 'dir mgon po'i bstan pa'o// de spyod pa'i dus ni da lta'i dus man chad de/ ma rungs pa mang pos bstan pa nyams smad gang thub byed pa ni mig lam na mngon sum pa/ de dag la snying rjes bsad na khong tsho'i don chen por 'gyur ro// zhes dgongs so// gnyis pa gang zag gi lan ni/ gang zag la yang gnyis su bshad// bsgral bar bya ba'i gang zag dang*// sgrol bar byed pa'i sgrub po ste// zhes pa'i dang po/ dkon mchog gsum po smod pa dang*// bla ma la sdang bdag la smod// de dag sogs la bya bar bshad// sogs sgras/

sems can spyi la 'tshe ba dang*// sdig pa'i las la rngams pa dang*// ngan song gsum la gzhol ba dang*// bdud kyi phyogs su lhung ba dang*// mu stegs byed la sogs pa ltar grub mtha' ngan pas lam gol bar lhung ba lta bu rnams/ de yang*/ dang por sdig pa la dga' yang*/ phyis dad pas bstan pa la bya ba cher nus pa rgyal po mya ngan med lta bu 'byung srid pas dus 'khor nas/ mngon spyod la sogs pa mngon shes thob pas bya bar gsungs la/ gzhan du dang po rims la sogs dung ba'am ltas ngan pa dang cho 'phrul dbab pa la sogs bred bsdigs bya/ des 'chun nas 'dun na slar gso zhing gal te mi 'dud par da dung bya ba ngan pa de dang du len par spro na de dad pas 'phongs pa mngon sum pa yin pas phyis bsad pa'i las bya bar gsungs so// sgrub pa po ni rnam pa gsum// he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor ma// dag cing sbyangs te ting 'dzin gsal// rim pa go 'phang thob pa ste// zhes rab lta ba rtogs pa ste/ de la dregs pa rnams yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar bkur zhing mchod pa'o// 'bring ting nge 'dzin gyis 'chun pa ste/ de la jo bo ltar du bkur zhing bka' nyan pas so// mtha' ma rtsal gsum bsnyen pas 'chun pa ste/ des ci bsgo ba'i las byed cing phrig mi nus pas so// rtsal gsum ni/ lus lha/ ngag bzlas brjod/ sems dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa ste/ de dag ni btsan po'i mkhar du mi shigs pa'i sku bskyed de/ gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhes bya'o// thun mong spyi dang bye brag tu// dam tshig gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin// zhes pa ni/ de la dam tshig la gnas pa ni thams cad du gtso ba ste/ legs nyes kyi stangs gcod pa la dam can 'di rnams 'khrungs pas nyams na lha bdud du 'bab la/ ma nyams par gtsang na ci bsgo ba thams cad bsnyen bsgrub ma byas kyang ngang gis byed pas so/// / gsum pa gnas kyi lan ni/ gnas kyi khyad par 'byung ba yang*// bsnyen pa'i dus dang sgrub pa dang*// las la sbyar ba'i dus shes pas// yid 'ong dben dang dur khrod sogs// bsam gtan 'phel dang khyad par ro// zhes bshad pa ni/

bsnyen pa ni yid 'ong bkra shis pa'am brag ri nag po kha lhor blta ba'i phug dben par/ sgrub pa brgyad sogs dur khrod la sogs pa bde mchog dang mthun la/ 'phrin las sna tshogs ni/ so so'i bsngags pa der bsgrub dgos/ gzhan du mi 'grub pas/ slob dpon pad+mas/ sde gnas sbyin sreg byas mal du// ser ba bsgrubs na mi thon zhud// dbang bskur tshe bsgrub byas mal du// thun phran bsgrubs na mi thon zhud// mchod rten tshwa tshwa bshig pa dang*// stong nyid gsung bklag mal nyid du// ltas ngan bsgrub na mi thon zhud// phung shul bsad bcad g.yul bkye'i sar// mngon shes bsgrubs na mi thon zhud// dug sbrul sa ral shag 'phung shul// nor bsgrub byas na mi thon zhud// ces bshad pa lta bus so/// / bzhi pa rnal 'byor gyi spyod yul la bdun las/ dang po sgrub pa'i lan ni/ yul dang dbang po'i spyod yul du// mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang*// reg pa dang ni dran pa yi// dkyil 'khor pa yi snang ba dang*// ma lus dngos por gang shar ba// bde ba can du shes par bya// snang tshad sku phyag rgya chen po/ grags tshad gsung phyag rgya chen po/ dran tshad thugs phyag rgya chen po'i khyer so dang ldan pas bsnyen pa bya bar bstan la/ gang bsnyen na/ bstan pa kun las btus pa yis// byang chub sems dpa'i lam las kyang*// gsang ba 'bras bu lam byed pa// rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid de// zhes pas 'dir bstan pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po/ nges par brjod pa 'bum phrag so drug pa las bsdus pa 'di'o// de yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub tu chas pa'i lam/ ring ba dang nye ba gnyis yod pa'i phyi ma rdo rje'i gseb lam de nas so// bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung ba gsum// 'di ni khyad par bsrung ba yin// bstan pa ni rgyal ba rnams kyi chos lung dang rtogs pa'o// 'dzin pa ni klog pa thos bsam dang*/ spong ba bsam gtan no// des ji ltar 'dzin pa'i tshul ni/

tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas// sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ zhes pa'i tshul gyis so// skyong ba ni/ bsod nams kyi gzhis dge 'dun bsdu ba dang*/ chos 'khor 'dzugs pa dang*/ 'chad pa dang*/ rtsom pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi bde ba la reg par byed 'jug pa dang*/ shes rab kyis sbyangs nas gong nas gong du spel ba dag go /bsrung ba ni/ lo tog ser ba las skyob pa lta bu rigs pas rtsod pa dang*/ phas kyi rgol ba ngan pa chos bzhin du tshar bcad pa mthu dag go /de las 'di phyi ma'i dbang du mdzad do// de yang*/ bsgrub pa bsnyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ nye bar bsnyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ nye bsnyen nam nyer bsgrub gnyis dang po ni/ lus kyi lha/ ngag gi mtshang tshig sngags/ yid chos nyid kyi rtsal ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phro 'du dang sems ci byed gzhan don du bsams pas rang rgyud byin gyis rlobs nas/ dam can pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa lta bur 'du zhing des dngos grub ci 'dod pa 'grub pas bsnyen pa ste/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung ye shes che// rnam dag dam tshig kun grub la// bde ba'i bsod nams rgyun gnas pas// rnal 'byor stobs ni rgyas par byed// ces pas so// 'di la/ bsnyen pa'i dus su rang lha yi// he ru kar ni gnas pa yis// mdun du bka' sdod dam tshig gi /mgon po phyag bzhi bsgom par bya// de la cho ga'i chings/ lhag pa'i lhar sbyar ba dang*/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin te bskrad pa dang*/ mdun skyed bskyed pa/ byin gyis rlabs pa spyan 'dren pa/ mchod pa/ dam tshig ye shes bsre ba/ dbang bskur ba/ rgyas btab pa/ phyag btsal ba/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa/ mchod pa bzhi 'bul ba/ gtor ma btang ba/ bstod pa/ bzlas pa/ slar mchod bstod bya ba/ bsdu ba/ bsngo ba dang*/ bkra shis so// chings dang po ni gong non pa'i phyir te/ ye shes kyi mgon po dpal dregs pa lta bur sgrub pa'i skabs yin pas/

yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa lta bu'i bsnyen pa legs par 'thems pas 'di la 'jug go /gnyis pa bgegs dang log par 'dren pas rnal 'byor gyi nus pa 'joms pa bzlog pa'i phyir yin la/ mdun skyed bskyed pa nas bsre ba'i bar/ 'dir rang bzhin gnas pa'i hūm̐ las bskyed do// de nas dpal ldan bdud 'joms pa'i// sgrub pa yang dag rab tu bshad// ces sogs kyis rgyas par bshad pa'i snying po/ ston pa gnas pa rang bzhin las// phyir chad du ston pa bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa la/ gnas pa'i srog las rang bzhin du bskyed pa zhes bya'o// 'khor lo dgug bya gnyis med bstim/ rang rgyud ltar gnas pa'i mgon po sangs rgyas kyi zhing skyong ba rnams spyan drangs gnyis med du bsre ba'i bar bstan la/ dbang bskur rgyas btab pa ni/ gong du/ sgrub pa'i dus su mgon po yi// rgyas 'debs spyi bor he ru ka /de nyid ces pas bstan te/ dpal mgon po la he ru ka rigs bdag dang*/ gzhan rnams la de nyid ces pa mgon po nyid de/ bde mchog nyung ngur/ 'di rigs gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du gsungs shing*/ rdo rje 'phreng bar lha rigs ma nges pa dag la rdo rje sems dpa'am mi bskyod pas rgyas 'debs par bshad pa'ang de thams cad kyi bdag por dgongs pas so// mchod pa ni/ dam tshig ldan pa'i sngags pa yis// sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams khyad par las// 'bru nag gtor ma rab tu shes// zhes sdom 'byung du/ chang dang gtor ma med par ni// las rnams thams cad 'grub mi 'gyur// zhes pas gtor ma gtso bo dang*/ khyad par las/ zhes pas zhi rgyas dbang drag gis dbye ba phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid du bzhag pa'o// sha chen gyis ni brgyan pa yi// tshogs rdzas mchod pa gus pas 'bul// smad las te de skabs skabs su bya ba dang*/ stod las rgyun du bya bar gsungs pas/ rgyun dang gnas skabs las/ bsgrub dang bsgrub pas mngon du 'gyur// zhes so// zlos dus kyi ting nge 'dzin kyang 'di nyid du/

rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba// ri rab steng du yum bcas bsam// de mdun nag po chen po nyid// gsal ba bskyed tshul dbye ba yis// rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs pa ni// mngon gyur lta bur blta bar bya// bdag dang mdun gyi mgon po yi// thugs ka'i ting 'dzin rang sngags las// de las spro bsdu'i ting 'dzin bsam// zhes pa sngar mdor bstan du/ 'od 'phros 'khor ba'i bzlas pa ni// khyad par du ni sgra dang bcas// shin tu dpa' bar bzla bar bya// zhes pa'i don 'di'i rnam grangs su/ gri gug brtsegs par/ zla nyi'i dbus kyi sa bon la// stim bya 'od zer spros nas kyang*// khyogs ltar 'phreng ba lding gyur pa// de nyid rnam par gsal ba las// nus pa gzi byin myur bskyed pa// zhes dang*/ der srog gcod spang ba zhi ba ste/ sogs ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ rdzun smra las logs pa rgyas pa/ dbang drag po dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi bsnyen pas ni// rtsa ba'i nyon mongs rang dag 'gyur// gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa yi// spang bya du ma'i gnyen por che// bsod nams tshogs ni bsags pa yis// kha na ma tho'i dri ma 'dag /ye shes tshogs kyis rang bzhin gyis// kha na ma tho'i gnyen por 'gro// zhes dmigs pa'i khyad par bshad do// gzhan yang*/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od// ye shes me lce'i snying po ni// 'od gsal mkha' dbyings mi 'gyur ba// ngag brjod pa yi bzlas pa yang*// dpal 'dzin byin rlabs dus su bya// zhes myur ba'i gnad gsungs so// khyad par rtags ni gsal bar 'byung*// nye ba'i mtshan ma nges mthong nas// dngos grub blang zhing gtor ma 'bul// sbyin sreg las kyis myur du 'grub// gsang sngags 'bum phrag bcu yis ni// 'bras bu yid la 'dod pa 'grub// kha skong me yis mchod pa bya// zhes le'u bcu dgu par bshad/ de yang grangs rtags dus gsum du bzhag ste/ de yang rab 'bring mtha' ma yis// bye brag rtag tu 'char bar 'gyur// grangs ni bdun 'bum dag dang ni// khri phrag dgu dang khri phrag bdun// stong phrag bdun gyis nye bar 'gyur// thabs dang shes rab bcas pa yi// sngags kyi stong phrag bcu dag gis// mngon sum gsal ba'i nges pa 'char// dus ni zla drug zhag bdun bar// rnal 'byor smra ba bcad de bzla// mi tshig bar ma chod pa yis// gsang sngags 'phrin las nges par 'grub// thun mtshams mchod dang gtor ma dang*// bstod bcol zhes gsungs so// 'dir 'phreng ba bsnyen dus/

ru rak+ṣa/ dung chen/ gzhan shel gyis zhi ba 'grub sogs kyis so// rgyu grangs byin brlab gri gug brtsegs par/ shes pas lha yi ting 'dzin gyis// 'phreng ba gang nas rnyed pa la// khrus byas dris byug rang lag steng*// mi dmigs ngang las rang bzhin gyis// byin rlabs spro bsdu mchod pa bya// gsang sngags brjod la bcad par bya// 'dir rang bzhin zhes pa dam pa rigs brgya/ sngags brjod rgyu dbyangs gsal lo// 'dir mgon po phyi rol tu blta ba ma bzlog par bsnyen pas phyi sgrub/ nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ nye bar bsnyen pa'i dus su ni// bdag nyid he ru ka las ni// hūm̐ byung mdun du spros pa las// bskyed cing mthar ni nye bar bsdu// bcu dgu par/ gtor ma chen po dang bcas pas// lan bdun nye bar bsnyen pas 'grub// mgon po 'khor bcas bskyed pa'i rgyu dus kyi hūm̐ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas spros la des sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor blta ba'am/ mthar ni nye bar bsdu zhes pas zhal myur du lta ba'i man ngag de'i dbang du mdzad nas gri gug brtsegs par/ chu skyes dbus su rdo rje ni// sa bon 'od 'phros mi bzad pa// nyi zla drag po snying po las// rol mtsho'i phyogs gyur gnas pa yi// pad+ma phyogs bcas 'phreng ba'o// ge sar 'dab klu gnas gyur te// srog nyid ye shes bdag nyid can// snying po rgyun du bskul ba'o// nye ba'i nyon mongs dag pa'i tshul// lhag mar gyur pa'i nyes pa sdom// lha ni me dang phyogs dag gi /dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyur pa yi// lha mo nyer bzhir bde bar rol// spyod dang grol ba'i ngo bor mthong*// 'di la gsang rten lus la bca' ba zhes kyang gsungs so// snga mas phan 'dogs byar song bas sam nye ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin pas nye bsnyen no// lha rang sems kyi sprul par bsgom pas sam/ lus kyi nang du 'gongs pas phyir ma chad pa'i phyir nang bsgrub bo/// /

gnyis pa sgrub pa chen po'i lan ni/ bsgrub pa chen po bla na med// ye shes mgon po chen po ni// khwa gdong la sogs lha mo brgyad// dam pa bzhin du yongs su bskor// dkyil 'khor pho brang dbus su yang*// dur khrod du ni mgon po rol// 'jig rten gsum na rnyed dka' ba'i// dam tshig spyod pa'i rang bzhin ni// rtag tu rang sngags sbas pa ste// rab tu 'bad de gsang bar bya// zhes mdor bstan/ dkyil 'khor chen po ston pa'i las rim dang 'brel ba'i gzhung tshig gis thams cad rgyas par bshad do// 'di la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rnam pa gnyis/ sngon 'gro la/ sa chog sta gon gnyis/ dang po la/ sa brtag bslang sbyang zhing gzung ba bzhi/ snga ma la sa brtag pa dang lto 'phye brtags te brko ba gnyis/ bar pa la slob mas gsol ba btab pa/ bgegs sdig pa mi shes par sbyang ba/ bsnyen pa bya ba/ mtshan ma thob nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su bsnyen pa dang 'dra bar bdag mdun bskyed mchod/ mi snang ba la bslang ba/ mtha' ma la/ bgegs sbyang sri mnan pa sbyang ba rnams/ bzhi pa la/ dkyil 'khor yod sa'i dbus su bdag bskyed/ gsol btab/ khro bo bskyed pa/ bka' bsgo/ stangs stabs/ slob ma bsrung ba/ sa de la mchod pa/ le'u bcu bdun par/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba// dpal ldan nag po chen po yi// thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' ba// nas/ rgyud shes yang dag bla ma la// snod ldan dag pa'i slob ma yis// gsol ba lan gsum gdab bya ba// nas/ lan gsum brjod nas gnang bya ba'i// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ dang por bsnyen pa brtsam par bya// mtshan ma nye ba'i tshul shes nas// de nas sngon 'gro brtsam par bya// 'phrin las mchod pa gtor ma yis// ye shes lha rnams mchod pa dang*// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi ni// sdig pa 'bral zhing bgegs dbyung ba'i// sngags dang bcas pa'i yungs kar gyis// me sbar bsreg dang brab par bya// bgegs la bka' bsgo gtor ma byin// slob ma kun la bsrung byas nas// de rjes sa phyogs gtsang ma la// sa brtag pa dang sbyang ba dang*// sa bslangs nas ni bka' thob pas// brko zhing ro lnga bsal bar bya// de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yi// bka' yi 'khor lo rnam par bsgom// dang*/

de las brjod pa tsam gyis ni// phur bus gdab dang brdung bar bya// rdo rje mgon po chen po yi// ting nge 'dzin du gnas pa la/ gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin// des rjes thal sbyar gsol ba ni// sogs dang*/ bgegs la bka' bsgo gtor ma byin// dang*/ de nas bsrung zhing bcag par bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs nas ni// rdo rje goms pa'i gar stabs kyis// hūm̐ hūm̐ drag po'i sgra brjod pas// phyogs kun bcings pa byas nas ni// dang*/ slob ma kun la bsrung byas nas// dang*/ khyad par bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bsrung*// zhes pa'i dngos shugs kyis bshad do// sta gon la/ sa lha bum pa slob ma lhag gnas bzhi// de nas lhag par gnas pa brtsam// sa 'dzin lha mo nyid mchod pas// bka' byin nas ni thim par blta// dang*/ dkyil 'khor dri yi thig le la// me tog chal dgram lha rnams ni// bskyed cing mchod la gnyis med bteg /ces dang*/ bum pa bkra shis yan lag ldan// ma nyams mtshan nyid ldan pa dgu// kha tshar ma nyams ras zung dkri// snying po sman dang 'bru lnga pa// spos dang rin chen dag gis dgang*// rgyun 'bab chu yis gang ba dang*// 'bras ldan shing gis kha brgyan pa'o// de nas sems bskyed sdom gnas pas// dam tshig gsang ba sbyin par bya// dang*/ so shing dor nas ltas brtag pa// bsrung skud ku sha sbyin par bya// rnams kyis so// bsgrub pa chen po'i dngos gzhi la// thig byin rlabs gdab pa/ tshon byin rlabs bri ba/ spyan gzigs dgram pa/ rten 'dzugs pa/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ bdag 'jug pa/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba/ dkyil 'khor de nyid du dngos grub dang 'phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'o// de dag kyang rim pa bzhin/ khyad par lha la gsol btab nas// rdul tshon dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya// dang por ye shes thig gdab cing*// de nas dam tshig nges par gdab// go rim ma nor nges pa'i tshul// srad bu shes rab can gyis gdab// tshon ni byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// pra brtag rdul tshon rim pas 'gyed// ji ltar bris pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa// rta babs bzhis ni mdzes pa yi// pho brang le tshe dgu zlum skor// dbus ma e dbyibs drag po nyid// pad+ma 'dab brgyad phyi rol ni// lha khyams bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog

/ces gsungs la/ nang drag po er bshad pa'i rigs pas/ phyi ma zla gam gsum ldan pa/ blta tshul la zla gam drug ldan kyang 'thon pas phyi zlum po zhi ba/ de'i phyi gru bzhi rgyas par bshad pa ni/ zhe sdang rigs pa grags kyis mdzad pa'i las gsang gi bka' 'grel las/ dbus kyi pho brang e yi dkyil// ral gri'i rtsig pas drag po 'dul// zla gam drug ldan dmar po dbang*// chos sku spros med mu khyud zlum// gri gug dag gi rtsig pa yin// mi 'jigs bzhi rgyas gru tshad bzhi// bar gyi khyams dang sgo bzhir ldan// sku gsum ldan phyir thod brtsigs gsum// zhes 'byung ba dang*/ slob dpon rat+na ā ka ra gup+ta'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen 'phreng bar ji skad bshad pa bzhin de'i rjes su 'brangs la/ der/ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsum// gru bzhi par ni mnyam pa la// pho brang nang ma dur khrod kyi// gzhal yas thod pa'i rtsig par ldan// mu khyud rim pa gnyis kyis bskor// phyi ma pho brang le tshe brgyad// de yi nang gi e dbyibs na// zla gam gsum ldan dbus su ni// mu khyud rim pa bskor ba la// pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar bcas// zhes 'byung la/ 'dir gti mug 'dod chags zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i brdar klad khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho bshad cing*/ pho brang ni/ gur chen po'i nang du chung ngu phub pa lta bur sku dkyil gyi nang du gsung dkyil chug pa'i rim pas shes par bya ste/ 'dir ni srin po'i rgyal khab dper mtshon te bshad pa'i phyir ro// lhag ma/ rin chen 'dod snam bskor ba dang*// drwa phyed ba ku lī yi 'phreng*// ya steng kha bad mdzes par brgyan// chos 'khor ri dwags gdugs dang bcas// thod skam pad+ma'i phreng bar ldan// dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor// rdo rje me 'od 'bar ba 'khrigs// las dkyil ni/ yang na le tshe dgu ldan pa'i// pad 'dab brgyad kyi phyi rol tu// mu khyud 'khor lo rim gsum du// e dbyibs zhing skyong rim pas dgod// lha dang sa bon phyag mtshan ni// sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyas mtshan// zhes so// dgram pa ni/

nye bar brgyan cing yongs su bskor// dang*/ rten 'dzugs pa/ lha dang sa bon phyag mtshan ni// sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyas mtshan// dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ gsang sngags nye bar bsngags pas gnas// bsten cing mchod la gsol ba gdab// bsgrub tshul rgyas pa/ bdag mdun bum pa bsgrub pa gsum// dang po/ tshogs gnyis la gnas pa/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs/ gur khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor/ de la mchod bstod bzlas pa/ gzhal yas khang*/ rgyu dus kyi mgon po/ mngal 'byin gyis 'khor bskyed pa/ glus bskul ba/ 'bras dus kyi lhar bzhengs pa/ byin brlabs/ ye shes dgug pa/ mchod pa/ gzhug pa/ dbang*/ rgyas btab pa/ phyag mchod bdud rtsi myang dang bstod pa/ 'dzab dang ting nge 'dzin nyer bsdu rnams so// de yang le'u lnga par/ 'gro ba kun la rab bltas nas// sogs nas/ de nyid hūm̐ dang bcas pa yang*// nā da tsam du gnas pa las// nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las ni// tshangs pa'i gnas bzhis khyab par bya// zhes sogs kyis dang*/ de las sa bon 'di dag ni// lte ba ge sar bcas dbus su// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ ha las sna tshogs rdo rje ni// nas/ 'di dag bsrung ba'i khyad par ro// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ni// nas/ bkug nas gnyis med bzhugs par bsam// khro bo de dag re re zhing*// brtan par bya phyir gsang sngags brjod// dang*/ oṃ dkar 'khor lo dang bcas pa// nas/ rdo rje dang ni nor bu yi// 'od zer 'khrug pa'i rnam par ro// sku dkyil la rdo rje rin po che dang*/ gsung nor bu'i 'od zer can te/ rtsig pa'i rgyu bshad pa'o// pho brang nang ma zlum po la// nas/ drag po'i gnas su bsam par bya// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ dbus ma'i nang du baṃ las ni// nas/ de ltar yab yum rdzogs bskyed nas// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs byas nas// nas/ dkyil 'khor lha rnams rdzogs pa dag /ces pa'i bar gyis dang*/

de nas gtso bo yab yum dag /snyoms par zhugs pas 'od du zhu// nas/ a i zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de ltar bskul bar gyur pa las// nas/ bdud 'dul chen po brgyad kyi bar// dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas gdab cing*// dang*/ spro ba dang ni bsdu ba dang*// de nyid brtan dang mnyes par bya// ye shes gzhug dang dbang bskur dang*// byin gyis brlab dang 'di rgyas btab// mchod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi myang dang bstod cing bskul// sngags kyi rten byed bzlas pa bya// ting 'dzin don bsam nye bar bsdu// zhes pa rnams kyis so// 'dir bsgrub pa chen po dang 'brel ba'i bsnyen pa ste/ rang rig dmigs med gcig pu sgyu ma tsam du khyer bas phyi nang gi 'dzin pa med pas gsang sgrub/ de'i phyir bskyed rim rang rkyang gi dbang du byas pa la bsnyen pa bya ba'i sgo gsum yod pas mdor bstan du/ gsang ba zhing skyong rgyal po che// cho ga gsum gyis bsgrub pa'i tshul// zhes gsungs shing*/ de kha'i sngon du/ gsang sngags phyogs bcas pa// de nyid sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsam// zhes pa'i rkang pa phyi ma phyi ma'i bzla dus kyi ting nge 'dzin yin la/ gsang sngags phyogs zhes pa bzlas tshul dam tshig bzlas pa sogs bcur bshad pa'i dbang du byas so// bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel du bsnyen pa'i dbang du byas nas de'i mthar/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i bdag /thams cad bde chen gnas pa la// dus gsum 'khor lo gsum du gnas// brtul zhugs 'dzin pas thob par 'gyur// zhes mdor bstan/ de yang*/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po tsa mi sangs rgyas grags pas sbyor ba'i 'phreng ba zhes pas gsal bar bstan pa/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud 'joms pa las rlung 'gog pa'i sbyor ba/ phung po'i bdud 'joms pa 'dzag pa bcing ba'i sbyor ba/ 'chi bdag gi bdud gzhom pa bcud kyis len gyi sbyor ba/ lha'i bu'i bdud gzhom pa sgyu 'phrul gyi sbyor ba/

bdud bzhi cig car du gzhom pa btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba dang lnga'i dang po/ dbyug gu dag pa'i pho nya dang*// chu tshod kyi ni mi mo dang*// 'pho ba gnod sbyin brgya phrag gnyis// thun ni pho nya brgyad dag go /dus sbyor bcu gnyis gnas pa'i yul// nyi shu rtsa bzhi de yi phyed// rtsa rlung yi ge khams la rgyu// 'ching grol tshar bcad rjes 'dzin pa'o// zhes bshad pas/ las rlung 'gog pa tshar bcad dang*// dbu mar 'jug pa rjes 'dzin no// sbyor ba gnyis pa ni/ khyad par ye shes bla med pa// dam tshig mgon po sgrub pa yi// dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che// bde bar gshegs pa'i lam spyod mdzad// 'dis thig le thur du 'pho ba dgag pa bum pa can bstan te/ brtag gnyis su'ang*/ dpal ldan de bzhin nyid gshegs shing*// zhes pas yas 'ongs la 'chad/ de dgag pa bum pa can 'chings pas yin pa'i phyir ro// byang chub sems kyi zla ba 'di// yar ngo mar ngor rab tu gnas// yar ngo yis ni bskyed byed la// mar ngo la ni grib par byed// yar ngo yi ni bco lnga la// byang chub sems kyi mkha' 'gro yang*// bde ba chen por 'du bar mdzad// 'di ni nges pa'i don du gsungs// zhes pa thig le go bzlog tu gnon pa srog thur bsre ba'i sgo nas bsgrub par bstan no// sbyor ba gsum pa/ gsang ba sngags kyi 'khor lo las// lha yi 'khor lo rgya mtsho ni// lan tshwa chu rgyun 'bab pa'i ngang*// zhes pa rgas pa gzhom pa rlung zas su za ba/ gangs kyi thigs pa bdud rtsi'i chu// me tog mdangs gsal snying po yi// ge sar ze'u 'bru ldan pa la// 'dab rgyas ye shes nyi shar bas// rang grol mdangs 'bar rab tu rgyas// zhes pas 'chi ba skyengs su gzhug pa bdud rtsi skom du btung ba bshad do// sbyor ba bzhi pa/ rdo rje ral gri rin chen dang*// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dag las// zhes pa stong pa nyid rnam pa kun ldan gyi lha'i gzugs goms par bya ba bstan la/

'khor ba'i rgyun las 'od zer 'phro// zhes pas mngon shes sogs mngon par 'dod pa bsgrub pa bstan no// sbyor ba lnga pa/ steng 'og dag las rim pa ni// 'khrug cing gcod pa'i gri gug gis// las dang 'phrin las rang byung du// byed cing sprul pa'i las 'grub pa// phyi nang gsang ba rim bzhin du// dbab dang sngags dang bzlog pa ste// rtsa ba yan lag las bzhir 'gyur// dang po thun mong dgu pa ste// gnyis pa bye brag phyed pa dang*// bskyed pa ye shes mi bzlog pa// klungs su tshud pa phyag rgya che// snying po gcig la dus gsum du// 'gyur med de nyid dbye ba nyid// zhes pas phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bshad do// de yang*/ de kho na nyid kyi sgrub pa ste de phyir sgrub pa bzhi ldan du song ngo*// mdun bskyed ni/ dkyil 'khor rten rdzas thams cad la tshig 'don pa gcig gis/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes sems dpa' gsum bsre/ dbang bskur bzlas pa'i bar bsnyen pa bzhin du bya ba ni/ de nas ldang bar gyur pa na// gnyis pa lha rnams thams cad kun// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs byas te// de yi ngang la ting 'dzin ni// gsang ba rdzogs par bya ba'o// zhes pas bstan la/ bum bskyed ni sta gon bzhin du bya'o// rang nyid dam tshig gso ba'i phyir yang bdag 'jug len la/ gzhan la dbang bskur na nges par blang ste// sam+bu ṭar/ slob dpon smin pa'i las kyis ni// slob ma yongs su smin par bya// zhes so// bskur ba'i dbang la/ sngon 'gro 'jug pa/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur/ rjes yon 'bul gsum/ dang po/ 'jug pa la phyi rol/ nang gsang ba'i 'jug pa gsum gyi dang po/ khrus dang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol btab/ sdom pa/ mig dar bcing ba/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bskon pa/ gtsug tor bcing ba/ me tog 'phreng ba 'dzin du 'jug pa/ dri ba/ lan/ rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa'o// de yang*/ slob ma khrus byas rgyan gdags te// maṇ+ḍal me tog khrus bya zhing*// ras kyi mig ni bkab nas su// zhes pas dang*/
