nang 'jug yol ba'i nang du khrid pa/ bskor ba/ phyag bya ba ste/ mtshan ma mthong bas legs par drangs// sgo bzhi nas ni nang 'jug cing*// zhes pas so// gsang 'jug dam bzhag bzhi/ gsol btab/ byin dbab/ ma phebs na spogs chog phebs na gshegs gsol/ kha dog dri ba/ las so so grub par go bar bya ba dris slob ma bsangs/ 'dzab/ sngar bzung ba'i me tog byin gyis brlabs te dor ba/ rigs 'di'o zhes brda sprad pa/ des me tog slob ma'i mgor bcing ba/ mig dar dgrol ba/ dkyil 'khor brten pa rten dang bcas pa bsdu ba ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin dbab pa/ gu gul bdug cing ting 'dzin gyis// nag po chen po'i lha tshogs kyang*// nges par spyan drangs bstim par bya// de la nges par rtags rnams 'byung*// yang na so so'i mgon por bskyed// ye shes sems dpa' byin gyis brlab// bla ma dkyil 'khor gtsor byas la// 'od 'phros rang byin brlabs par 'gyur// mthong ba dri dang bdud rtsi gtor// gdong g.yogs bkrol zhing lha ngo bstan// dang*/ sngar/ dang por me tog gtor bar bya// dam la bzhag pa bzhi 'di'i sngon du 'gro bar rgyud sde phal mo che'i phyag srol la yod cing rgya gzhung du gsungs so// da ni 'dir cung zad dpyad na/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis bskyed pa ni thun mong ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pas// rtag tu brten cing spyad par bya// rnam par rtog pa las mi mthun phyogs ltung ba 'byung ba dang*/ de rang bzhin yongs su shes na bde ba chen po yin pa'i phyir/ rnam rtog bag chags kyis bcings pa// rtog pa dag pa'i thabs mchog ldan// rnam rtog rang bzhin yongs shes ni// de nyid thob tu med pa ste// bde ba chen po yang dag 'byung*// zhes so// de kha ye shes lnga'i mdangs su shar bas rigs lnga/ de'i dbang gis 'phrin las thams cad bya ba rnal 'byor pa de'i brtul zhugs yin pas/

tshig nyung kyang don rigs lnga'i dam tshig drang nges kyi rnam pa thams cad 'thon pa yin no// yang dag bla ma mnyes par bya// 'dir ni byang chub sems kyis su// bsnyen pa nye bar bsnyen pa dang*// sgrub pa bsgrub pa chen po yi// khyad par rim pa rtags dang dus// las la sbyar ba shes par bya// bla ma mnyes pa dngos grub kyi gzhi'i gnad/ lta ba phyag chen las ma g.yos pa 'khor ba gcod pa'i gyabs kyi gnad/ sgom pa sgo gsum sku gsum du khyer ba rtsal sbyong gi gnad/ spyod pa ci byed thabs kyis zin pas bsgral bya dbyings su 'dren pa gdug pa 'dul ba la mkhas pa'i gnad bzhi ma ste/ 'dir khyad par gyi dam tshig tu bzhag go /rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa ni/ rdo rje theg par/ sems rnam pa gnyis ni/ kun rdzob kun da lta bu dang*// don dam bde ba'i gzugs can no// zhes pas/ de gnyis la slob tshul rgyud sde phyi mar/ dang po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshon pa dang*/ gnyis pa rdo rje rtse lnga pas so// nang mar dang po ni zhu ba/ gnyis pa ni bde ba/ de'i phyir zhu bde lhan skyes rnal 'byor du 'gyur ro// de tsam 'jug pa'i dus su bskyed pas bskyed rim tsam gyi mthar yang phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor la slob tu rung ba'i gnad shes par 'gyur ro// 'dir dbab rgyu'i lha ni dpal rdo rje nag po chen po nyid dam las kyi mgon po la sogs pa las gang 'dod pa dbab par bya'o// dngos gzhi dbang bskur la bum gsang shes rab tshig dbang*/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang lnga'o// de yang gleng bslang du/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'jom pa po// zhes pas/ lus ngag yid ye shes kyi dri ma bzhi 'khrud pas dbang bzhir song la/ gang la de bzhi'i ma rig pa 'gags pa'i ye shes su grub pa nyid/ rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam gyur pa'i// zhes pa'i tshig gis bstan te/ de ni/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid cher// der 'os te thams cad du ma rig pa las log pa'i phyir sangs rgyas bzhin no// ci'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa zhe na/

dngos grub thams cad ster byed pa// zhes pas/ gzhan dbang bzhis khrid pa'i slob dpon du'o// 'dis sems 'grel gyi dgongs pa bzhin bum pa'i dbang la slob dpon du gsungs pa drang don/ dbang bzhi pa'i mthar de ster ba nges pa'i don du bshad la/ thams cad du spros pa dang bcas pa dgos sam snyam na ma yin te/ dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'grig na tshig gcig la ma bltos par yang pra ba dang me shel nyi 'od gsum 'dzom pa'i me lta bur dbang bzhi mod la 'thob pa'ang*/ 'phral du yang dag yid ches byed// ces gsungs la/ de bas lam rgyud la brten par bya ba yang*/ 'dir/ bsam pa gang dang gang dag gis// mi rnams sems dang mthun par 'jug /de dang de yi gzugs sprul te// sna tshogs g.yogs te bde bar bzhugs// zhes pas 'drer 'dzin gyi rtog pas 'dre/ lhar 'dzin gyi rtog pas lhar 'gro bar bshad de/ rje btsun la/ rnam rtog dgra ru ma langs na// nga brag srin dgra ru ci la sdang*// zhes pa bzhin de bas 'dir lhag pa'i lhar blta ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa nas brtsams te bum dbang*/ de'i lam la bslabs/ de nas gsang dbang dang*/ de'i lam/ de nas gsum pa bskur/ de'i lam/ de nas bzhi pa bskor/ de'i lam/ de'i mthar rdo rje slob dpon du skor ba'am/ stan thog gcig tu bskur te de kas grol bar byed nus pas sam/ ma nus na de smin byed du bzhag nas/ phyis de la grol byed ston pa/ de nas dbang po'i bye brag gis// nges par rim par dbang bskur ba// 'di lta bus ni dpal rgyal ba'i dbang pos/ dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag sbyin pa'i sgros gsum la bstan bshad bsdu ba'i tshul gsum du bshad pas dbang bskur nyid 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i gseb lam dngos dang*/ rdo rje theg par grol lam rim pa gnyis sogs bshad pa yang dbang bskur nyid du shes na rdo rje theg pa'i gsang rig pa yin no// zhes dpyad do// de lta bu'i bum pa'i dbang de la/

gsol ba btab pa/ bgegs sbyang ba/ rigs lnga'i dbang*/ rjes gnang 'dogs dang bcas pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ 'dogs ni/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang drug go /de dag kyang*/ bstan pa 'dzin zhing bstan pa skyong*// bstan pa srung bar byed pa yis// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel mdzad pa// sku yi mgon po sogs bcas kyis// bla med dngos grub sbyin pa'i phyir// yang dag ye shes dbang bskur ro// zhes pas rigs drug gi dbang ngo ti dang*// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// 'phrin las lha yi khyad par ro// zhes pas 'dogs drug mdor bstan/ me long ye shes bdag nyid can// nas/ mnyam nyid so sor rtog pa dang*// bya ba nan tan chos kyi dbyings// ye shes lnga yi rigs kyi gtso// nges par dbang bskur bstan par bya// 'phrin las bzhi yi dbang yang bskur// lha mo brgyad kyi las rnams sgrub// zhes pas rigs lnga de'i mtha'i rjes gnang rgyas par bshad/ bum pa spyi bor sbyin pa dang*// zhes pas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i ngo ti dang*// de rjes ba ling gtad pa yis// nus pa thogs med sbyin pa yin// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mchog /lha dang sngags kyi zab pa'i chos// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya che// 'dogs rgyas par bshad do// dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i dbang bskur ba rnying ma'i rgyas 'gebs so snyam pa'ang deng phyin dor zhig gsang dbang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba btab pa/ mig dar/ phyag rgya 'bul ba/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te sbyor ba mdzad pa/ thig le phyung des gnas bzhir thig le khar sbyin la mig dar bkrol/ dbang don bshad pa/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi blug pa yi// thod pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mgo bo'i// bdud rtsi ni/ der gnas pa'i byang sems sbyor bas phab pa/ de blugs pa ni slob ma'i khar ro// dbang gsum pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal/

gsol btab mig dar/ phyag rgya gtad pa/ lha bskyed/ mkha' gsang byin brlab/ sbyor ba byed du bcug nas/ mig dar dkrol ba/ de yang*/ gsang ba bde chen ye shes nyid// ces pas zhu bde dbang gsum par byas la/ bzhi pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba btab pa/ dbang don bshad pa ste/ rang byung dri med dbang bskur ba'o// de yang zhu bde'i lhan skyes 'gyur med du dag na de kha dbang bzhi pa yin la/ de yang gsum par lhan skyes brtan nus na/ der so so rang rig nges par 'ong la/ des dngos grub mchog gi rgyud rnyed pas bde mchog tu/ yid ni nang du chud pa yis// 'dod pa'i dngos grub bsgrub par bya// zhes 'byung bas so// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol btab/ slob dpon/ po ti lung sbyin/ brtul zhugs gnyis so// de yang*/ 'di nyid dngos grub kun gyi gter// zab cing rgya che dngos grub pa// skal ba can la sbyin par 'os// zhes pas bstan no// de nyid du/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rdzas bkod/ thun mong gi bsgrub pa brgyad bsgrub pa dang 'phrin las gang yang rung bas tshar bcad pa'am phan btags pa bsgrub par bya ste zla ba dang lo la sogs pa'i bar du rgyun mi 'chad pas so// yang 'dir bsgrub pa chen por 'gyur ba ni tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du bya ba ste/ rgyal po dzas ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i tshul bzhin gyis tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyangs/ dag pa'i snang ba bsgrubs te/ sbrul lpags pa brje ba bzhin du ye shes kyi skus sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du rgyu bar bya'o// de dag kyang le'u lnga par/ chags pa med pas kun tu spyad// 'di de'i rang bzhin rnal 'byor pa// zhes 'phrin las sgrub pa sogs dang*/ rigs ma rnams la rol byed na'ang*// de nyid shes pa bcing med de// rnam par rol ba'i tshul mchog go /zhes gsungs pas so/// / gsum pa 'phrin las kyi lan ni/ 'phrin las khyad par gang yin pa// las la sbyor ba rim shes bya// rengs par byed dang skrod pa dang*// rmugs par byed dang brgyab tu 'jug

/thams cad rmongs dang lkugs par byed// dug gis 'dzin dang 'on longs dang*// rang sha rang gi za byed cing*// gshis ngan dug dang khrag tu skyug /'di dag dus min 'chi byed pa// las kyi khyad par yongs su bstan// zhes pa'i rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis las spyir bstan la/ lhag mas mngon spyod mdor bstan no// 'phrin las la rnam par dbye na/ zhi drag gnyis/ zhi ba la zhi rgyas gnyis/ drag po la dbang dgug mngon spyod gsum/ dang po gnyis gcig tu bsdus na las bzhi/ thugs rje 'byung bar/ de nas las chen dpag med kyang*// bsdus pa zhi rgyas dbang drag dang*// lha dang sngags dang dmigs pa'i gnad// de yi go rim bzhi bzhir 'gyur// zhes so/ phyi ma la/ bsad pa dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ lus ngag yid rengs par byed pas gsum dang*/ srid skam pa dang*/ gso ba dang*/ sbyin sreg gi las rnams a bha yā ka ras mdzad pa'i man ngag gi yi ger byung*/ de'i bsad pa la/ bzhi snying sbas pa srog gzer nag po'i rgyud du/ spu gris bsad dang thun gyis bsad// snying gzer dang ni reg gcod dang*// lto dkrugs dang ni srog tig dang*// 'byung dkrugs dang ni srog gzer gyis// bzhi snying bsad pa rnam pa brgyad// lha dang sngags dang dam rdzas dang*// dug dang thun dang 'khor lo dang*// gtor ma sbyin sreg bzhi bzhi yi// snying po gcig tu dril la bsad// ces gsungs la/ de'i bzhi snying gis bsad pa brgyad/ de nyid du/ gtor mas bsad dang sbyin sreg dang*// zor gyis bsad dang mdos kyis bsad// mnan pas bsad dang ltas ngan dang*// bzlog pas bsad dang thun gyis bsad// nag po gtor mas bsad pa ni// nag po rnams kyi sha khrag la// gtor chen gcig la gtor chung stong*// 'bru sna sman dang snying sna stong*// nag po'i nyi ma bdud 'char la// bzhi snying bzlas shing khrag thun gtor// gtor ma re la dgra gzugs re// sngags ring drag po'i dbal gyis 'bul// dgra bo gnas pa'i phyogs su bskyal// des ni lan gsum thal nas 'chi// dug gi tsher ma spun dgu la// drag po'i hom nag zur sum bya// sngags byang liṅga rtsa brgyad bri// dug khrag snying 'bru nag po dgu

/bzhi snying bzhi stong bzlas pa yi// zla ba mtha' ma stong bzhi la// sreg pa nyi shu rtsa bdun sreg /bu ga dgu nas khrag gzags nas// dgra de ma lus dus min 'chi// phung sa nag po spun dgu la// zor gyi kong bu zur gsum brgyad// nag po'i khrag bkang dug nag dang*// 'gong rdzas yungs nag mtshe nag rtsang*// dug mda' nag po spun dgu la// than sgro skyon rdo dug khrag byugs// bzhi snying stong bzlas dgra yul 'phang*// des ni dgra rnams kha phung 'chi// 'bru sna nag po spun dgu la// mi nag dar mdung thogs pa brgya// gnod sbyin thogs ser 'phen pa brgya// ma mo nad rkyal thogs pa brgya// ce sbyang 'ur pa rgyug pa brgya// rgyang bu mda' 'phang ru dar dang*// nam mkha' shing bris gdung brgya dang*// sha khrag gtor bcas bzhi snying ni// bzhi stong bzhi brgyas rbad la btang*// dgra rnams dus gcig brlag par 'gyur// gtor chen/ hoṃ/ zor/ zor mdos rnams bshad la/ lhag ma rdib grir gsod pa dang*/ dngangs te gsod pa dang*/ lha dang dral te gsod pa dang*/ sbos grir gsod pa'i tshul rnams gsungs so// srog gzer nag pos gsod pa ni thod nag tu grags pa ste/ tsa mi'i las sbyor chen po gtso bo des drug mar grags pa kha skongs so// gzhan yang char dbab pa dang*/ sprin dbral ba dang*/ thog dang ser ba dbab pa dang*/ rang phyogs su ni bzlog cing bsrung*// byad kha bzlog dang kha 'ching dang*// nus pa gzhom dang cho 'phrul dang*// phran tshegs las kyis bsad pa'o// de dag rnal 'byor pa rab kyi dbang du mdzad nas bsam gtan gyis 'grub pa zhes gsungs te rdzas sngags kyi bya ba la mi ltos pa'o// 'bring gi dbang du mdzad nas sngags kyis 'grub pa zhes gsungs te/ bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nas las sbyor bya bar bshad pas so// mtha' ma lha'i stobs dang rdzas kyis te/ lha'i stobs ni/ thugs rje 'byung bar/

gtso bo ye shes mgon po la// ma mo mkha' 'gros bskor ba ni// spyi bsnyen yid bzhin nor bu yin// las mgon nag po mched bzhi la// ging chen lha mos bskor ba ni// snying tig nag po'i srog bsgrub yin// dper na myur mdzad la dbang phyug dzi na mi tra la sogs pa ging gis bskor ba/ gdong bzhi pa la sring mo lha mo bzhis bskor ba/ hūm̐ mdzad la lha dang gshin rje dang bdud dang gnod sbyin brgyad dam las kyi mgon po gdong can bzhis bskor ba bshad pa'o// bka' sdod nag po mched brgyad la// pho brgyud dregs pas bskor ba ni// lto dkrugs gsang ba'i man ngag yin// mgon po stag zhon la sogs pa'i sger sgrub/ ro langs dmar mo spun bdun la/ sha za bye bas bskor ba ni// snying gzer nag po'i sgrub pa yin// 'dir ro langs dmar mo ni las kyi tsaṇ+ḍi ka /de'i mched mkha' 'gro drug /gsang ba'i yum chen ma bdun la// dbang phyug ma mos bskor ba ni// tsit+ta gsang thun drag sngags yin// dbyings yum/ sbyor yum/ sgrol yum/ re ma ti bzhi rnams gtso bo nyid dang sbyor ba'i phyir ma bdun no// las kyi gshan pa mched bzhi la// nag po stong gis bskor ba ni// gshed po lto dkrugs drag sngags yin// gza' klu btsan ging*/ bdud mgon nag po spun gsum la// mun pa'i bdud mos bskor ba ni// lcam dral srog tig drag sngags yin// bdud mgon ni sha za seng gdong yin/ spun gsum ni lga los/ dug gsum mgon po spun gsum gyi btsan du bshad pa ste/ zhe sdang gi mgon po seng gdong*/ gti mug gi mgon po lcags mgo nag po'am 'jigs byed dus mtshan nag po/ da lta zhing skyong gi 'khor du rdzu ba'i bam ro 'di ka yin/ 'di la legs ldan gyi rgyud du yang legs ldan nyid khros par bshad yod do// 'dod chags kyi mgon po las gshin/ ro langs drag po smyon pa la// mkha' 'gro drug gis bskor ba ni// spu gri reg gcod drag sngags yin// 'di mu stegs gu lang yin/

de ka la lha chen po shrī ral pa can/ dbang phyug khrag ral can la sogs par grags/ sgo mtshams kyi mkha' 'gro brgyad kyi las/ lha mo bya rgod mgo can mas rengs pa'i las byed do// sogs dang*/ zhing skyong rnams kyis/ de dag grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma// dngos grub stsol bar the tshom med// sogs dang*/ rgyal po bzhi la/ phyogs bzhi yongs su skyong ba yi// nas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed pa// 'di nyid grub pa ster byed pa'o// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ 'di nyid du/ rnam sras kyis rgyas pa'i las grub pa mang du bshad pa/ gri gug brtsegs par/ gang po mdzes ma'i sgrub pa bshad pa ni gnod sbyin ming sring yin la/ sring mo la rdzong gi lha mo zhes bya ba'i rgyud du mar bsngags te/ de yang sngags stobs kyis bkug nas/ des mkha' spyod du 'khyer bar bshad pa lta bu sogs re res kyang las thams cad nus kyang gtso bor de dang de la bsngags so// re ma te bzhi gzhan du bshad pa'i sgo ma bzhi yang yin te/ shar gyi lha mo 'phrog byed mas 'gugs pa'i las byed do// lho'i lha mo glang sna mas 'ching ba'i las byed do// nub kyi lha mo ral pa can gyis sdom pa'i las byed do// byang gi lha mo sa'i gtsug gis myos shing dbang du byed do// zhes pas so// gzhan gsung dkyil gyi sgo ba la sogs pa'i lha'i stobs ni khrag mtsho khol ma sogs las bshad do// don du lha gcig nyid kha dog phyag mtshan la sogs pa'i dbye bas las so sor bsngags/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po/ rtag pa'i rdo rjes dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba dang*/ nad gdon 'joms pas zhi ba dang tshe sgrub/ mgon po 'jam pa'i rdo rjes shes rab dang rgyas pa/ chags pa'i rdo rjes dbang bsdud dang dgug pa/ zhe sdang rdo rjes mngon spyod/ 'phrin las thams cad pa'i rdo rjes las thams cad par ro// de nas sbyin sreg gis bsgrub pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/

dkyil 'khor ba'i lha'i 'phrin las kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas zhi ba'i las bsgrub pa la ni bil ba la sogs pa'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad du bya'o// 'bras ldan gyi shing gang las rgyas pa'i las bsgrub na stong phrag gis bya'o// kha di ra'i shing dang dmar ba'i shing gis ni dbang bsgrub na khri phrag gi bya'o// shin tu rtsub pa'i tsher ma dang ldan pa'i shing dag gis ni mngon spyod la 'bum phrag gis bya bar shes so// zhes sogs las so so la/ khyad par gri gug brtsegs par/ sbyin sreg me lha mchod pa dang*/ thab khung sreg rdzas yam shing dang*// 'dug phyogs gos dang phyag rgya bsam// sngags dang spel tshig 'phrin las bcol// gtor ma mchod pa go rim bzhin// kun la sbyar ba shes par bya// zhes dang*/ drag po la/ las gsang bar/ liṅga mang na gnad mi phebs// sreg rdzas mang na las kyang 'gyangs// sngags mang rang la bzlog de'i phyir// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rdzas kyis 'grub pa ni bskrad pa la shing gi lo ma rlung dmar byung ba'i tshe sa la ma lhung ba blangs te gzugs brnyan bris nas yul gzhan gyi hor pa la btags te btang bar bya'o// sogs kyis dang 'phrul 'khor gyis 'grub la// mar ngo yi ni tshes brgyad dam// gza' skar shin tu drag po la// de nas 'khor lo bri bar bya// sogs kyis so// 'khor lo yang*/ zhi rgyas la yig mgo phyi dang*/ drag po la nang*/ des na dbang yang drag po'i dbye bar dgongs nas gnod sbyin 'khor lo lta bu la dbu rug ma mdzad// mo 'og pho steng du rnam pa thams cad du bshad do// rab gnas ni/ 'khor lo dgug bya gnyis med bstim// sogs kyis/ rten dang bla rdo'i 'khor lo thams cad srog gi rang bzhin yin pas chags pa'i rten nam 'du ba'i rkyen du dmigs/ bsad pa'i 'khor lo ni mtshon cha'i dbal du nag po dgra bgegs kyi srog la 'debs kyin 'khor ba/ mnan pa'i 'khor lo bsgrub bya liṅgar bstim/

de'i lus ngag yid gsum ri rab sogs kyis mnan pa'o// dbye ba ni phan tshun du dbye bya de'i bar du rlung lha yab yum sras 'gong po la sogs pa mi mthun pa thams cad kyis dbye ba/ bskrad pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi khar bsgrub bya rnga mong la bskyon te rgya mtsho'i mthar bskyal ba sogs su dmigs pas lhag ma rigs 'gre'o// pho 'khor g.yas mo 'khor g.yon// 'ga' zhig las/ sngags pho la mgo phyi/ mo la yig mgo nang du bstan par yang bshad do// 'dir sngags kyis 'grub pa ni/ las so so'i sngags shes dgos te/ de yang*/ zhi ba la mā ra ya/ bsad pa shān+tiṃ dug tu 'gyur ba lta bus so// ting nge 'dzin gyis bsgrub pa yang*/ spu gri klad gzer nag por/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la sngags kyi bskor bar bsams la/ zhi ba la yi ge kha dog dkar po/ rang gi zhal nas mgon po'i zhal du zhugs par bsam/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas brgyud pa la zhi ba'i las bcol ba la mgon po mi bsnyel ba dang*/ bar du gdon gang zhi bar byed pa'i zhi ba dang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas brgyud pa de rang gi nyon mongs pa la sogs pa zhi bar bsam mo// rgyas pa'i skabs su yi ge ser po la 'khor lugs gong bzhin du gsungs pa las/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'khor dus su rang gis rgyas pa'i las bcol ba la mi bsnyel ba dang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'khor ba'i dus su tshe dang dpal la sogs pa rgyas par bsam/ dbang gi dus su kha dog dmar po mgon po'i zhal nas rang gi zhal du zhugs par bsam/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'khor dus dbang gi las bcol bas mi bsnyel bar bsam/ bar du 'khor dus gang dbang du bya ba rgyal po la sogs pa dbang du gyur pa bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas rgyu dus su gang dbang du byed pa de dbang du gyur par bsam/ mngon spyod kyi dus su yi ge kha dog nag po la 'khor lugs dang po dang 'dra/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'khor dus su mngon spyod kyi las bcol bas mi bsnyel bar bsam/

bar du 'khor ba'i tshe dgra bgegs la sogs pa rnams bsad cing gtub par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'khor ba'i dus su rang gi bar chad zhi bar bsam zhes dang*/ las thams cad pa la nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud du/ snying gar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐// nag po de la rtsa sngags kyis// bskor bar bsams te bzla dus su// sngags 'phreng 'khor bar bsam zhing bzla// 'od zer lnga 'phros las bzhi 'grub// khyad par du yang gdug pa rnams// tshar bcad dbang du bsdus par bsam// zhes so// gzhan yang kham zas gos/ 'dug stangs dus/ gza' skar/ phyag rgya ma la sogs pa'i stobs kyis bsgrub pa so sor shes par bya ste/ gri gug brtsegs par/ bsnyen pa tshes gsum brgyad dang ni// bcu bzhi nyer gnyis brgyad la sogs// las sbyor drang srong dbang byed dang*// mgon po rgyu dus 'phrin las ni// sgra gcan gyis ni las byed pa// de dus sbyor ba byed par brtag /nyin zhag cha las rab dbye bas/ gnas skabs rtags dang sbyar bar bya// sogs kyis so// phyag bzhi 'phrin las bzhi yin pas de'i phyag mtshan bzhi las de dag ji ltar bsgrub pa ni/ gri gug brtsegs par/ ro langs kyi ni lce lta bur// gshin rje'i lce 'dra'i gri gug gi /ral gri'i dngos grub phyag mtshan nyid// stobs chen dpa' bo'i zil gnon che// thams cad zil gnon bzlog pa'o// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga las sku gsum ster// ye shes thugs rje zhi ba nyid// yang na rtse gsum 'jigs byed pa// gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod byed// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun phab nas// 'tshe ba 'byung ba kun las bsrungs// thod pa'i snod ni bzang po ru// bdud rtsi'i rdzas bsgrub dngos grub blang*// kha sbyar ting 'dzin spro bsdu yis// ril bu sbyar bas mchog tu ster// rā sa ya na bcud kyis len// 'chi med grub pa'i rdo rje 'thob// ces pas gri gug dang ral gri las mthun par bshad la/

gong du/ rnal 'byor pa la grub ster ba'i// las kyi sna tshogs pa zhes pa be ta'i 'bras bu la sbyar ba yin no// de bas na gri gug dang be ta mtha' gcig tu nges pa med par bla ma rnams gsung ngo*/// / bzhi pa thabs las kyi lam rim pa'i dris lan ni/ thabs ni las kyi rim pa ste// rten gyi gang zag 'ga' zhig gis// dang por bla ma mnyes par bya// gnyis par dbang bzhi thob pa dang*// gsum par byin gyis brlabs nas ni// bka' bsgo rjes gnang tshul bzhin du// ma nor 'jug pa'i lam rim shes// bla ma mnyes pa dang*/ dbang bzhi thob pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon du byin gyis brlabs pas/ bka' bsgo zhes/ rgyal bas bstan pa bsrung bar ro// rjes su gnang ba ni gsang sngags kyi las rim mo// de yang*// mngon spyod mthu'i dbang du byas pa ste/ bsrung bzlog bsad gsum/ sreg 'phang mnan gsum ste las drug tu bsdu la/ bsrung ba ni dmag go bgo ba lta bu/ bzlog pa dmag bsham pa lta bu/ bsad pa g.yul ngo sprad pa lta bu/ sreg 'phang mnan pa mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis pha rol 'joms pa lta bu'o// 'di dag bum dbang dang 'brel ba tsam gyi las yin pa la/ dbang bzhi dang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa ci'i phyir bshad snyam na bsgral 'dren nus pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ 'bad pas snying rje bskyed pa nyid// bsad par bya ba brjod pa nyid// snying rje med na mi 'grub pas// de phyir snying rje bskyed par bya// zhes pas so// de la yang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum/ bar pa 'bod rbad/ phyi ma la bsad pa/ de yang las gsang bar/ dang po 'bod la zhag bdun bya// dus ni bcu gcig dag la shis// rtags ni rnam pa gsum yin te// rab ni dngos su 'ong ba yin// 'bring ni sgra ru ston pa yin// mtha' ma rmi lam dag tu 'ong*// de nas rbad pa zhag bdun bya// dus ni nyi shu gnyis la shis// rtags ni rab 'bring gsum du 'ong*// mon dang ā tsa ra nag po// rgod cing ci bya zer 'ong rab// lcags spyang khang phyir bskor byas 'bring*// bya nag mon pas 'khor zhing lding*// mtha' ma'i rtags su shes par bya// de nas bsad pa zhag bdun bya// dus ni nyi shu bzhi la shis// rtags ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod// shing gcod ro gcod sha bskos rab// zhub can dmag sna 'dren pa dang*// khyi nag drung 'ong 'bring gi rtags// lings dang khyi ra byed pa ni// mtha' ma'i rtags su shes par bya// rtags 'og tu rgyas par bshad de rgyas pa thugs rje 'byung bar/

de yi las mtha' yang dag bshad// brgyad tshan brgyad kyi go rim las// gnad 'ching gegs dang bla rdo ni// gsang ba'i las chen nyid du gsungs// mchod dang las tshogs cha lag ni// nang gi las tshogs yin par bshad// mtha' gnad brgyad ces phyi yi las// zhes pa'i phyi'i brgyad ni/ lha'i/ gsang ba'i/ sngags kyi/ bsrung bzlog gi rdzas kyi/ rtags kyi/ mtshang tshig bskul ba'i/ dam tshig bsrung ba'i gnad brgyad la mtha' gnad brgyad ces gsungs so// dang po ni/ spyir ye shes pa'i rtsal gsum gyi bsnyen pa rdzogs par byas la/ sgos su las gang byed kyang sgrub pa'i sngon du bsnyen pa kha gso/ pho bsgrub na mo ni 'khor dang las byed lta bur dmigs/ sngags ni pho'i sham bur mo/ mo bsgrub na mo ni yum mam 'khor gyi tshul du'am chung ma'am sring mo tshul du bsnyen na snying nye/ pho rje bo lta bu la mo bran gyi tshul du bsten na las myur/ thugs rje 'byung bar/ pho ni nag po bdud kyi rigs// drag cing myur la rtsub par 'gyur// mo ni dkar mo lha yi rigs// 'jam zhing rno la 'gyang bar 'gyur// pho bsgrubs mo rtags 'byung ba na// de yi dgra rnams phung bar 'gyur// mo bsgrubs pho rtags byung ba na// des kyang dgra rnams phung bar 'gyur// zhes so// zhes spyir pho mo rten la gnas pa phyi nang gsang ba'i rten bla rdo srog 'khor lus la bsrel ba'o// ye shes kyi lha 'grub dka' bas 'jig rten las byed sham bur gdags so// bsnyen dus gang bsgrub kyang gtor ma dang*/ snying sna/ khrag bdud rtsi rnams kyis mchod cing*/ dung ba bskyed/ bsnyen pa'i sngags chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bzla zhing*/ zo dal bar bya/ bsnyen pa la drags na rbad bsad kyis dus dub nas sun 'gro ba yin la/ 'di dus dmigs pa 'di/ bdag gnyen po dang las byed bdag mdun/ thugs ka'i sngags kyi 'od zer phar 'phro tshur 'phro/ lhag par dregs pa'i mthu stobs thams cad dam can de la bstim gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/

yang yang mchod cing bstod dbang du bsdu ba'i phyag rgya yang bsten/ mtha' tshig brjod pas shin tu 'dris par bya ba ste/ dper na mi gcig la grogs po 'tshol bar 'dod na dang por 'dris btsal/ 'dris nas bza' btung nor sbyin/ de nas mna' tho sbrel ba 'dra ba yin no// de lta bu'i bsnyen pas rang rgyud pa la gnas na mi yong ba'i dbang med de/ sngon rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa yin pas bka' las 'da' mi srid pa'o// rbad pa mi de la gla byin nas las kyis zer ba lta bu/ bsad pa ni mi des de la nyan nas las la zhugs pa lta bu'o/ de yang rbad dus mthun pa'i dam rdzas sbyin las bcol bas rang rgyud par 'dug pa'i dbang med do// rbad pa'i sngags ni srog 'phen par byed pa'i phyir/ sngon gyi mtha' tshig dran nas las byed do// gsang sngags ni mtshon ngar ma dang 'dra ste dmigs bya'i lus srog 'bral bar byed pa'o// de yang 'bod pa'i dus su sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis tshur 'gugs/ rbad pa'i dus su phar bskul te dgra'i bla dgug pa'i phyir rbad/// / gnyis pa gsang ba'i gnad ni/ mthu gtad kyi las gang byed na'ang*/ rten gyi las khyim/ gnad kyi srog khyim/ btags chags kyi rdzas khyim/ rtogs pa'i rta khyim/ srid pa'i gter khyim/ rdzu 'phrul gyi sbra khyim rnams kyi don go zhing shes dgos/ de dag tu sde brgyad kyi gnas lugs/ srog las/ sde brgyad du/ dbye ba'i rgyu mtshan sgrub pa'i thabs rnams ston pa yin no// gzhan yang las byed mkhan de gsangs nas gzhan la kha 'chol ba ste/ dper na gza' la chos skyong snying tig yin na de gsangs nas kun tu ging chos skyong gi gtso bo yin zer ba lta bu'o// yang bsten gyi med rgyu bar yang gsang ngo*// de ltar ma byas na gzhan gyis rtsad bcad nas zhu 'gras 'dus bzlog sla ba yin/ gzhan yang gsang sngags gsangs bas grub/ ma gsangs na 'chal te chos skyong nus pa chung 'phrin las bcol kyang zhum nas las 'gyang ba yin no/// /

gsum pa sngags kyi gnad ni/ bsnyen sngags la/ rbad dang thun dang yā gsum spang*// dung dung breng breng dzaḥdzaḥgazhug bsgrub dus swā hā/ bzlog hūm̐ hūm̐ spangs te/ bh+yo bh+yo/ thun thun/ ya yā gdags las sbyor// nri dzaḥ mā ra ya/ srog la hur thuṃ gdags pa lta bu/ bzla lugs/ bsnyen dus chu bo'i rgyun 'bab lta bu/ sgrub pa drag la mi bsrun par ri gzar gyi rbab ltar bzla/ las sbyor ni ce spyang sha la rol pa ltar bzla ste rngams la snying rje med pa'o// 'bod pa spang la me mched pa ltar bgrang*// rbad pa mgar gyi tsha tsha 'phro ba ltar bgrang*/ bsad pa dug gi char 'bab pa ltar bgrang*// mnan pa dug lo 'khyil ba ltar bgrang*// zor sngags ral gri so 'debs pa ltar bgrang*// sbyin sreg hoṃ spor ba ltar bgrang bar bshad do// dregs pa pho mo thams cad kyi thugs ka nas mi 'gyur ba'i srog la/ sngags pho brgyud la g.yas/ mo brgyud la g.yon du 'khor te gnas pa bzhin bsam/ bzlog dus 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pas srog gnad nas bskul bar bsam/ bzhi pa bsrung bzlog gi gnad ni/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo thams cad sngags mgo phyi/ bsrung bya dbus/ bzlog pa'i 'khor lo thams cad sngags mgo nang*/ bsrungs bzlog sbrags ma la spel mar drag sngags kyi gzhung mang por bshad do// sngags pa nang rgyas byung na rang dang 'khor ma kun la gdags/ kho'i bsrungs ma la gser skyems gtang*/ bden pa bdar/ shags gdab dpang gzugs/ kho'i liṅga la thun dang phur pa gdab/ srod la kho'i bsrungs ma bzlog pa'i las byas/ nam phyed la bla srog dgug cing bsad pa'i las bya/ tho rangs zor drag po 'phang ngo*// lnga pa rdzas kyi gnad ni bzhi ste/ 'bod rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ bskang rdzas/ rten rdzas te/ de dag tshogs na dam can rang bzhin du 'du zhing las ci bsgo ba byed do// gzhan yang las dang mthun pa'i rdzas/ zor/ sreg rdzas/ mnan rdzas tshang bar dgos so// de la dang po snyan pa dbyangs dang rol mo snom pa gsur chen sogs dri/

spyan gzigs rkun chen lag pa la dar sna btags pa de/ mda' la brgyan pa'i g.yab dar/ khrag mtsho khol mar/ bhaṃ paṃ saṃ baṃ ghaṃ/ mi rgod gtum po tswau ra pa'i// lag g.yas dkyil du 'khor lo ni// rtsibs lnga'i yig 'bru kha dog lnga// sor mo la ni mtshan sngags dgod// mgul par spel tshig dbang sdud bri// grir shi'i lag sor dar sna lnga// 'bru sna'i tshom bu dgod dang dril// zhes/ 'di spyir dbang du sdud/ khyad par 'bod pa'i rdzas gtso bor bla ma'i man ngag las shes so// dam tshig gtsang mar/ gdung ba'i shugs rnams/ gnyis pa spyan gzigs steng du gdugs bla bre sogs yol ba lda ldi mda' dar 'phan lha lhub/ phye phur/ dgra cha/ dkor cha/ rgyan cha dang*/ las dang mthun pa'i mchod pa/ de'i gtso bo sman raka gtor ma'o// gsum pa phyi ltar bskang ba mdos/ nang ltar bskang ba gtor ma yas thags der dar 'bru sna rin po che snying sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ mdos chog tu gsang ba mdos zhes 'byung ba'i gsang ba ni sngags kyi dam rdzas yin pa la dgongs so// gsang ba chos dang rjes su mthun par chos bsgrub pa dang*/ tshogs/ 'di la dang por mchod/ bar du bshags shing skong*/ mtha' mar gdab pa bshad pa'i mtha' ma// ma nyams grir shi'i bam blangs la// ma traṃ ru dra bstim nas ni// sogs bam gyi bskang ba bshad pa 'dir bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// rten rdzas bla rdo yin pas 'og tu 'chad do// 'jug pa rtags kyi gnad ni/ dam can grub pa'i rtags ma byung bar las la brdzangs kyang mngags pa'i gnas su mi 'gro/ 'grub pa yang rtags kyis gsal la/ de yang dam can gang bsgrubs kyang sngon la bgab 'dre'i rtags/ dpe dkar dang gza' lta bu la the'u rang*/ tshogs bdag la seng gdong lta bu/ mo brgyud la te phur ma'i cho 'phrul 'ong bas/ de rnams byung ba bar chad yin/ de nas 'khor gyi 'dre srin rnams kyi cho 'phrul 'ong bas yid brtan mi rung*/

rje dpon nyid kyi rtags byung na yin/ de yang pho bsgrub na rmi lam du skad rigs mi gcig pa/ mdza' bo brten pa dang*/ tho bcad pa dang*/ yul gyi mi chen dang*/ blon po zhang blon dang*/ bon po mi reng mang po/ zhub can/ pha khu/ gtso bo stag shar/ bro pa/ brtsad po/ btsun pa/ byis pa/ mon rgya/ rta pa/ stag seng*/ mi nag grib so/ mun pa/ me 'bar/ chu brub pa'o// mngon sum du yang 'ong*/ shug pa/ 'tsher ba/ brda/ 'bod pa/ khang pa 'tsheg pa/ sgo khrog pa/ me stag 'phro ba/ rdo 'phen pa sogs so// mo brgyud la brtsad po bye mo ma sring chung ma mdza' mo/ bud med g.yu zhu can/ cod thod can/ sma ra can/ gcugs pa/ bu mo shon byed pa/ rgya mo/ bal mo/ mon/ 'bri rgod/ g.yag rgod/ bya mang po/ mo rigs mang po/ dgo ba/ gnyan/ phyag byed pa sogs bkur sti/ rbad rtags dmag la chas pa/ mkhar brtsig pa/ go gyon pa/ mda' gsir ba/ mtshon brdar ba/ 'chings byed pa/ dmag 'dren pa/ brag gshog pa/ shing gcod pa/ rtswa 'breg pa/ me spor ba/ chu brub pa/ rlung chen g.yo ba/ khrom chen sdud pa/ mi mang pos bdag la dga' ston byed pa/ de ltar byung na las la tshud pa yin no// bsad rtags/ dgra pho mo dngos bsad pa dang*/ ra lug sogs srog chags bsad pa/ rtsi shing gcod pa/ ri dwags rgya la 'thums pa/ 'dab chags rnyi la zin pa/ khrom sha 'gyed pa/ khrag bskyil ba/ pags pa bting ba/ mgo bregs pa/ glo snying za ba/ dmag tshogs yul mkhar bsgyel ba/ go can 'khrug pa/ mtshon rnon po bsrel ba/ mi mang po g.yul sprod pa'i bsham rwa/ ri snyil/ sems can mang po shi ba/ chu chen pos yul grong bshig pa/ bdag gis dung phu ba/ rnga brdung ba/ dar 'phyar/ gso btab pa/ brub khung nang du rkang rjes byung ba/ shi dri mnam pa/ sems can brdung ba/ de dag kyang lan re lan gnyis kyis mi chog shin tu bstan pa dgos so// rang 'gro snying 'dod pa/ snying mi dga'/ sgrub khang la yid mi chags pa/

sems spur ba/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ bag grang ba/ rmi lam du bud med rdzud pa/ sprang long*/ bud med chags pa dgug pa byung na dam sri'i rtags/ dgongs pa bskyed/ sems dgug phyag rgya gsal btab/ dam sri mnan/ dza brdungs bya/ bzlas brjod sgrim/ khro zhing tshig lha 'dre nang 'khrug bdag la gnod na dam can 'khrugs pas bskang bshags bya/ tshogs gtor bzang du btang ngo*// gnyid rmugs myos pa/ byed snying mi 'dod pa/ khams mi bde ba/ srungs ma yel le byas mi 'khor na nyams grib khon grib mi gtsang pa phog pa yin pas khrus bshags bsdam grib sel gang thub bya'o// res nye res ring*/ res bzang res ngan na yid gnyis som nyi/ snyoms sems le lo gnyid rmugs kyi skyon yin pas the tshom bcad/ yid ches dam can la gdung ba skyed/ dgra bo la gnag pa ma yengs/ brtson pas dam can la 'bod pa bya'o// dregs pa gang bsgrubs kyang ltas bzang ba la dga' ba mi skye/ ngan pa la sdug snang mi bya/ 'jigs pa la ya nga spangs te dogs pa med par brtson par bya'o/// / bdun pa mtshang tshig bskul ba'i gnad ni/ bsnyen pa ma 'thems bar du las la mi bskul/ bsnyen rtags rdzogs nas sgrub pa la bla rdo bsrel/ mchod gtor bzang du bya/ dus bzhir bskul/ thun bca'/ liṅga brub khung du bcug lha dbye bla 'khyams pa'i dus su rnam shes dgug la bstim/ bskul ba la byung khungs skye brgyud nas bskul ba/ mtshang tshig gnad nas bskul ba/ che brjod bstod pas bskul ba/ phyag rgya gsal 'debs kyis bskul ba/ mtha' tshig gdung shugs kyis bskul ba'o// bsnyen sgrub ma 'thems bar bskul yang las mi byed/ 'thems nas dus rgyun du bskul/ rang la dgra med na bstan pa'i spyi dgra la bskul/ ma bskul na rang la 'tshe zhing 'khor la gzan/ bstan pa la gnod nges pa'i rim gro ba mi bya/ byas na rang dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ro/// / brgyad pa dam tshig bsrung ba'i gnad ni/

spyir sngags nas bshad pa'i rtsa ltung gis ma phog pa/ bye brag rtsa ba gsum yan lag lnga/ rtsa ba gsum ni bskyed rim bsgom pa/ bzlas brjod byed pa/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa'o// yan lag lnga ni/ sku'i yan lag tu bris sku sogs sku brnyan bsrel ba/ gsung glegs bam// thugs phyag mtshan/ yon tan tshogs gtor sogs rgyun lo zla/ 'phrin las sde brgyad rang rang gi gzhung nas bshad pa ltar bsten no// gzhan mi 'grub pa'i las mi 'chol/ 'grub pa rnams phyi bshol du mi bzhag dper na 'bod rtags brtan po byung nas rbad ma shes pa dang bla khugs rtags brtan po byung nas bsad pa ma sbyar ba lta bu dam can skyengs pa'i rgyur bshad do// gang bsgrub pa'i lha 'dre de dngos su byung na/ gnyen po lha bsgom/ gnyis med du bsre/ de la 'jigs pa skye/ yi chad na rang phung*/ gdung ba med na gong g.yel/ zhe sdang med na sgrol mi nus/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal na bka' mi nyan/ bsten thabs nor na 'khor la gzan/ lta ba med na dbang du mi 'du/ the tshom skyes shing 'dun pa med na las mi 'grub/ skyon de rnams spangs te las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'o// nye yang las byed du ma 'dod na/ gnad la dbab cing ar la gtad/ de yang srog gi snying po mas zlog bskul yang mas zlog des ma grub na srid pa dkrug srog snying dkrug rang yi dam mam gong gnon gyi lhar bskyed/ dam bdar/ gnad gzir/ zhe sdang drag po bskyed/ de ltar byas kyang ma grub na lan gsum spogs/ des kyang ma grub na dam can shi sa bstan/ de la spyir/ dam can de'i tsak+ka li dang*/ dam rdzas brub khung du bcer la thun gyis brab/ phur pas gzir/ de'i dus su snang srid thams cad bdag gi zhabs 'og tu gnas par bsam/ bye brag dam can de zhabs kyis mnan/ snying khrag zhal du brngubs/ nya bye tshan la bor ba ltar mig hrig hrig 'dar hed hed/ las ci bya zer bar bsam/

sngags mas bzlog drag tu bzla'o// brub khung du yang zhing lpags re g.yab brdab/ tshil chen gyi dud pa btang*/ la g.yogs bdar/ de'i tshul yang*/ lus gcer bu byas/ til mar byugs/ sol bas gdong nag por btang*/ zhing lpags gyon/ skra 'bal/ ba spu slong*/ mchi ma 'byin/ brang brdung*/ ngu zhing cho nge brdab/ thal mo lan bdun brdab/ bskor ba phyir log lan bdun bya/ ngag tu sangs rgyas kyi bka' rdzun no// phug pa zhwa ltar gyon/ lus srog 'ben du btsugs/ sha khrag gzan du bor nas bsgrub pa byas pas/ rnal 'byor nga gtsang shas nya bzhin myul/ dam nyams dgra bo gangs khongs kyi seng ltar rgyug 'jig rten 'di na bdag la mgon med dam/ khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag la mi dgongs/ sdang ba'i dgra la rtags ma byung*/ bstan pa'i ru tra la tshe srog med dam/ sngon gyi mtha' tshig 'gal bar mi 'gyur ram/ zhes brjod cing srid pa dkrug de ltar zhag gcig tu zhe sdang ma yol ba bya/ de nub gtor ma yang mi btang bar nyal bsdad/ de nas nangs bar tsaka li thun rdzas me long du 'char du gzhug bdud rtsi'i khrus byas so so'i sar bkod/ bshags pa byas la zhag gsum las sbyor bya'o// 'di ni dgra la lcags kyi srog rtsa yod kyang 'chi'o// shi sa bstan cing srid pa dkrug pa'i las 'di ni ci rung rung la mi bya'o// de yang thugs rje 'byung bar/ dbang bskur bsnyen pa phyi yin la// sgrub pa las tshogs nang gi yin// las sbyor drag po gsang ba yin// spogs dang gnad 'bebs mthar thug yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa nang gi la/ mchod brgyad/ las tshogs brgyad/ cha lag brgyad de gsum/ dang po la/ rbad bsad kyi dus gser skyems gtong ba/ gzu dpang 'dzugs pa/ 'di lha 'dre thams cad rang gi rogs su sbran pas kho la stongs grogs byed mkhan nyung zhing rang la dmag tshan che la/ 'jig rten na dmag grogs sdud pa lta bu'o// 'di 'dra ba'i dmag g.yab pa zhes bya'o// brub khung sogs bskyed pa/

bden bdar byas/ dgug bcing bskul ba/ sdig bsgo ste lha dang dbye ba/ bsad pa/ brdung ba/ btab pa dang brgyad do// rnam shes liṅga'i rten med par mi khugs shing*/ liṅga dgra'i bla rdo yin pas spyir btang*/ 'di la dgra gzugs/ de yang rjud pa/ rid pa/ ro'i gzugs 'dra ba/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa/ zhags pas mgrin pa bcings pa/ mig shi mig tu lta ba/ de'i snying gar dzaḥ kha sprod kyi bar du dgra la nri/ bgegs la tri/ de la ming rus bla gdags kyis bskor/ de yang pho yin na yig mgo phyir bstan/ mo yin na nang du bstan/ nang du dpral bar rus la che ge mo mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ sked pa la ming la mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ mgo la nan/ mdoms su tsha/ brla gnyis la bla gdags/ yan lag bzhi la dzaḥ gzhogs gnyis la rbad/ de yang pho gshed mo la rbad pa zhes bya ste dgra mo yin na yi ge de rnams pho grir shi ba'i khrag gis bri/ dgra pho yin na mo gshed pho la rbad pa zhes bya ste mo grir shi ba'i khrag gis bri/ srog gshed srog la dbab pa zhes pas bla tshe gang yin pa de'i snying khrag gis liṅga dmar por byug rang gshed rang la dbab pa zhes de ka'i zag rdzas dug gang 'dzom des liṅga la byug bsad pa'i ting nge 'dzin te phur pa gzir bsrung ba/ byin rlabs kyi kha sbyar dbye ba/ bdud bzhi gshed du bslang ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyis kha sbyar dbye ba/ tshe lung lnga la/ gnam gyi 'ju thag bcad pa zhes bya ste ye shes kyi lha la sogs pa'i byin rlabs kyis skyobs pa dang 'brel bas so// khrus lung rnam shes 'og min du bsgral ba/ 'di las kyi rnam smin dang 'grel bas sa'i rten phur 'byin pa zhes bya'o// de gnyis kyis bsgrub bya rang dbang du gnas pa'i skabs med pas 'chi bar 'gyur ro// bla 'gugs dus sam rbad dus/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu phyag rgya/ bdag lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka dang lcags kyu'i rgya'i rtser dzaḥ

de'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dgug bya gnas pa'i phyogs su song*/ de'i srog nri ru gnas pa de la btab nas 'then pas dmar nar gyis byung*/ brub khung gi rten dang gnyis su med par bstim/ de nas pho nya'i rtsal gyis dgug ste/ ye shes kyi lha/ 'jig rten pa kun la gser skyems bshos bu rak+tas mchod// gsur chen gyi dud pa btang*// dregs pa spyi bskul ba dang*/ pho nya gang yin pa de sgos su bskul lo// de yang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin pa'i lha mo bzhi la 'phog de rnams kyis rang 'dra nam mkha' gang ba'i sprul pa spros/ gzhan yang khro bo khro mo dpag tu med pa dang dam can rgya mtsho lha srin dregs pa phyag mtshan sna tshogs thogs pa dgra gnas pa'i phyogs su dmag dpung bzhin du 'chas nas/ yaṃ las las kyi rlung dmar gyis g.yos pas rgyab nas ded/ gnam lcags 'khor lo'i khar bsgrub bya bzhag lcags kyu ma rnams kyis lcags kyus snying phug zhags pas ske bcings/ lcags sgrog gis lus bsdams/ dril bus rgyab nas 'debs/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs/ 'jigs pa'i mun nag gis mdun bdar/ gshed mas btson khrid de 'ong ba bzhin nam/ byi'u khras ded pa ltar bdas nas brub khung der bcug nas dmigs rten liṅga la bstim par bsam mo// bye brag gang bskul ba'i srungs mas de bzhin no// lha dang dbye ba la/ rang gi lha dang dbyes 'jug pa/ che ge mo 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig go /dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs smad do// thugs dam la gnas pa'i bsam gtan dkrugs so// sngags 'chang bdag la bsdos so// srungs ma khyed la brnyas so// mthu bu lon bzhin du 'ded do// zhes pa lta bu/ kho rang gi lha dang dbyes 'jug pa/ bla glud gtor ma sbyin pa gzhung bzhin no// za lam bstan pa nangs nub tshogs dang gtor ma 'bul dus mchod rdzas de la dgra bo bkug ste bstim/

de'i sha khrag rus nang khrol du dmigs te 'bul lo// yang na mi'i rtsib ma la ming rus bris pa'am liṅga de dgra bor bsams la bstabs so// dgra'i sgo rtsar pho brang gdab pa ni/ thod ngan du 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre'i ming dang rus shes tshad bris la gzhugs/ thun sna dug sna khrag sna blugs ste de'i sgo'am khang pa'i rmang du sbas na lha 'dre thams cad der 'tshog cing 'du'o// dgra zun 'thab tu 'jug pa ni/ las sngags dang dmigs bya'i ming rus sbrel te/ des las mi byed pa'i dbang med pa/ dper na rbad pa'i sngags kyis/ che ge mo'i tsit+ta la yā zhes pa lta bu/ dmag zas dus su byin pa ni/ las drag po byas pa grub pa'i dus su rang gzhung dang mthun pa'i gtang rag gtang*/ liṅga yod pa kun kyang gtor ma dang sbrags te dbul lo// gser skyems dang ling ro lha 'dre spyi la gtong*/ de yang myur bar btang*/ phyis na bka' chad 'ong nyen che'o// dus rgyun du mchod pa la brtson pa ni dam can nye ba'i thabs so// gnyis pa las brgyad ni/ thugs rje 'byung bar/ srog dang cho 'phrul ser ba dang*// thog dang gtad chen sel nag dang*// nang rgyas bzlog dang bsrung ba ste// zhes dang*/ cha lag brgyad ni bzlog pa/ ngag mnan/ ngag dgrol/ bcing ba/ bskrad pa/ dbye ba/ mnan pa/ sri'u gso ba'o// gsang ba la/ gegs sel/ chings/ gnad/ bla rdo'i brgyad tshan bzhi'i dang po/ srog la byed na srungs ma skyengs dred 'byams gsum du ma song ba'i gnad shes pa/ skyengs pa ni las byas dus gtang rag ma btang bar de kar bzhag na 'byung ba/ dred pa ni yang yang mchod nas rbad ma shes na 'byung*/ 'jig rten na ming rus gcig pa mang po yod pas/ des nor zhing 'byams pa srid pas/ gsal shing 'dzugs pa'i gnad shes par bya ste/ shing gdug pa can cig la khram btab/ khram bar du dgra bo'i ming rus dang*/ pha tshan dang*/ pha dang ma/ bla gdags/ yul dang zhing la sogs pa bri/

sgrub khang gi rtsar 'phyar ro// sa la g.yon dang g.yas su bskor zhing brabs pas myur du 'grub bo// khungs bzhin du bsad pa'i las la ma sbyar na'ang 'byams te don mi 'grub/ rbad rtags rdzogs nas bsad pa la ma sbyar na yang don mi 'grub bo// ser ba byed na bo zags zhung gsum du ma song ba'i gnad/ gtad byed na log rdugs 'byams gsum du ma song ba'i gnad/ thog byed na zhud log 'byams gsum du ma song ba'i gnad/ ltas ngan byed na log rdugs 'byams gsum du ma song ba'i gnad/ sel byed na lo nor zla nor dus nor du ma song ba'i gnad/ seng ge kha 'thab byed na 'khor lo tshur 'khor/ lha srin tshur log ltas ngan tshur log gsum du ma song ba byed pa'i gnad/ 'khor lo bskor na thal rdugs 'byams gsum du ma song ba'i gnad do// chings brgyad ni/ srog la bsdo na bsad/ yul khams dgrar langs na ser ba/ phung du 'jug na klu la gtad/ sgos dang 'gras na gnam lcags dbab/ 'gran 'tshol na khang bshig dung rmad dkrug pa sel nang rgyas byung na seng ge kha 'thab bya/ rbod gtong byung na bzlog cing nus pa bshig rang gi phyogs bsrung ba rnams so// gnad ni/ srog la gtong na bsrung bzlog gis mi thub pa'i gnad/ ser ba byed na mu khrid du 'ong ba'i gnad/ gtad rang la mi bzlog pa gzhan la thebs pa'i gnad/ thog dmigs bya'i khang steng du 'bab pa'i gnad/ ltas ngan rang la mi babs pa'i gnad/ sel dur khang zhing gsum dkrug pa'i gnad/ kha 'thab byed na kho rang gi srung ma gnad du dbab pa'i gnad/ 'khor lo bskor na drag sngags sdeb pa'i gnad brgyad do// bla rdo brgyad ni/ rten bcas dkyil 'khor bzheng pa dang*// rten btsug rten bskyed de nyid bsnyen// zhes dang*/ rta nag lug nag g.yag rog khyi'i// mgul du snying po bris pa gdags// de yi ngo bo legs phul la// phyi yi rten du bya bar bshad// ces pa la/ rten du 'dzugs pa dang 'bul ba'i tshul gnyis so// des mtshon te dregs pa rang dga' ba'i srog chags de dang de'i rten du shes par bya'o// sna tshogs 'bru nag dbal byas pa'i// gtor ma mi shas brgyan pa 'di// pho brang rten dang brten par bcas// nang gi rten du slob pa'o// spyir gtor ma'i ngo bo thabs shes dbyer med/

dbye ba/ rten gtor/ gta' gtor mchod gtor/ gtor chen/ zor du 'phang pa'i/ rgyun gyi gtor ma/ bskang ba'i gtor ma brgyad/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po la dgod pa lhar bsgom rgyu/ gnyis pa ni dus rgyun du 'dzugs pa/ de la'ang rten dang mchod pa'i dbye ba gnyis/ gsum pa las ma 'grub par mi 'bul bar byin gyis brlabs te nam 'grub pa dang 'bul rgyu/ bzhi pa las kyis phye ba bzhi mchod gtor byin brlabs kyang*/ bya rog gdong gi rgyud du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sbyangs dang spel dang bdud rtsir bsgyur// zhes so// gtor chen ni gtor mas bsad pa de'o// zor du 'phang ba ni zor rdzas su byin gyis brlab pa'o// mtha' ma gnyis nges sla/ de la gcig la yang shes pa bzhi/ rten dus khang pa/ bsgrub dus lhar/ mchod dus kham zas/ 'phang dus zor du byas kyang rung ngo*// mdos kyang nang gi rten no// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyud du/ nang gi rten ni bya rog gi rgyal mtshan la ni dar nag brgyan// 'dab gshogs la ni sngags kyang bri// khar ni che ge bris pa gzhug /de ni sgrub khang steng du 'dzugs// zhes pas srog chags dngos kyi g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan/ nang rten du 'di shugs kyis bstan no// de nas nub phyogs dag nas ni// mi nag gsum gyis khur ba'i rdo// nag po dag la 'di skad brjod// nas/ 'di ni rang bzhin rten rdzas yin gyi bar dang*/ nag po'i ras sam dar la yang*// ting 'dzin sngags dang bcas pa yi// nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// bris pa nyin gcig gis rdzogs nas// bar chad med pa lus la 'chang*// gsang rten lus la 'chang ba'o// 'dis srog gi 'khor lo lus la 'chang ba bstan/ nam mkha' mnyam par/ gsang ba'i rten ni ka pā la// mtshan dang ldan par gri rgod snying*// dar nag gis gtum pho brang dbus// zhes bshad pas/ dkyil 'khor du dgod pa dang*/ bya rog g.yang gzhis brgyan pa yi// nas/ thugs kyi rten du gzung bar gyis sku// sngags bri ba/

phyag mtshan bcad ba sku gsung thugs rten du rim pa bzhin bshad pa dang*/ skyes pa grir shi'i thod 'phreng ni// yon tan ldan phyir rtag tu sba// mi bzad mtshon las byas pa yi// rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ bris pa// 'phrin las byed pa'i khyad par ro// 'phreng ba phyag mtshan yon tan nam 'phrin las kyi rten/ khyad par ye shes bla med pa// dam tshig mgon po bsgrub pa yi// dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che// bde bar gshegs pa'i lam sbyong mdzad// 'dis de kho na nyid kyi rten bstan te/ de yang dgra bo'i gshed du mngags pa'i tshe drag po'i mthu/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i tshe zhi ba dam pa'i chos/ dug gsum gyi sman pa mdzad pa'i tshe dag pa gsum gyi bskyed pa/ dam pa chos kyi srog shing 'dzin pa'i tshe gsang ba sngags kyi gnad/ ye shes kyi mgon por bsnyen pa'i tshe stong nyid snying rje gcig pa'i zung 'jug go /dam tshig mgon por bsnyen pa'i tshe/ thig le'i rnal 'byor te/ dkyil 'khor lha ni lus nyid yin// zhes sogs kyis so// lnga pa stobs kyi dri lan ni/ stobs ni chos rnams thams cad la// sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang*// yang dag bden pa'i stobs kyis ni// rang bzhin med par rtogs pa 'byung*// zhes bsgrubs pa'i mthu'o// drug pa 'jug pa'i lan ni/ 'jug pa thun mong ma yin pa// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa yis// 'gro ba'i don la sems pa po// zhes pas spyir byams pa rtsa ba/ snying rje sdong po/ byang chub kyi sems pad+ma'i snying po dang chos mtshungs pas snga ma gnyis rgyur byas pa'i byang chub sems la gnas pas ji skad bshad pa thams cad bya'o// khyad par zhi ba la btang snyoms pa'i sems/ rgyas pa la dga' ba/ dbang dgug la byams pa/ drag po bsgral ba snying rje/ de yang rgyu dus kyi kun slong snying rje/ de dus kyi kun slong zhe sdang zhes gong ma rnams gsung ngo*// bdun pa mngon du byed pa'i dris lan ni/

mngon du byed pa nyer sgrub ste// nas/ gtso bo dang ni 'khor rnams kyis// gang 'grub rab 'bring mtha' ma ru// rtags kyis dbye ba bstan pa yin// zhes pa rtags shes nas las rim par sgrub pa yin no// 'dir rtags ni bsnyen dus/ sngar bshad pa ni sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi skabs so/// / gsum pa 'bras bu'i dris lan ni/ rgyu ni thog ma med pa yi// rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ste// mngon sum du ni 'byung ba la// gang gis dgag par mi nus pa// de las 'bras bu phun sum tshogs// snying po smin pa bzhin du 'byung*// ji ltar rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa las 'bras bu sku gnyis grub pa ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'o// ji ltar 'khor ba zad pa las thar pa 'grub pa yang chu shing gi nus pa zad khar 'bras bu chags la 'bras bu smin pa na de rtsa ba nas bskams pa lta bu'o// snying po'i 'bras bu de/ gang du thogs med rdo rje yis// snying po zag pa med pa'i don// yang dag ye shes snang ba'o// bla ma'i drin las thob par 'gyur// 'dis mthar thug ye shes gcig ka yin la/ gdul bya so so la ni de ka sku so sor 'gyur te/ shel dwangs po dar gang gi khar byung ba'i mdog tu 'gro ba bzhin no// de ltar 'khrugs pa sdebs nas mngon par rtogs pa bslang ba'i tshul de tsam ste/ rgyas par yi ge mang pas 'jigs te gzhan glegs bam bklags pa nyid kyis go bar yang nus so bsam mo// gnyis pa le'us bcad pa'i gnad kyis cha shas su gsil ba rnam grangs su bstan pa ni/ rgyud 'di la le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga byung ba'i gnyis pa nas nyer bzhi'i bar gyis dngos su bstan pa don so so bar bshad pa/ rgyud 'di yang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyi 'gyur rgyas te/ der chos kyi grags pa dang nag po spyod pa lung bstan pa yod pa dang*/ khe gad 'gyur du mi snang la/ khe gad 'gyur dang*/ de gnyis kar dpe la skyon zhugs pas sngags btu cung zad ma dag ces bu ston gsung ba med par mthong la/

de tsam gyis rgyud de la log par rtog mi 'os te/ khe gad 'gyur la gdod kyis zhus chen mdzad pas shin tu dag par yang snang ba'i phyir ro// de lta bu mgon po'i rtsa ba'i rgyud du bshad de/ dpal lga lo'i slob rgyud rnams yongs grags kyi rgyud nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'chad pa sogs mgon po sna tshogs pa'i rgyud thams cad 'di'i bshad pa'i rgyud du bzhag nus pa'i phyir dang*/ dpal mgon po la sogs pa'i dregs pa'i rgyud mang po blos ma 'chel ba ni mi rigs te/ rgyud sde'i dbye ba na 'jig rten pa'i tshul gzung ba'i rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshad pa'i phyir ro// sus bshad kyang thams cad sangs rgyas kyi lung du 'grub ste de'i mthu las 'ongs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa le'u mtha' mas gsang ba bsdu ba'i tshul bshad pa ni/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba// gsang ba mngon par 'byung ba'i gnas// drang srong thub pa yang dag bstan// nges par gsang ba 'dzin gyur pa// gsang ba yon tan 'byung ba'i gter// ye shes mgon po chen po dang*// las kyi mgon po du mar bcas// dpal ldan lha mo nag mo ni// 'khor bcas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ste// dkyil 'khor gyi don bsdu/ gdug pa rnams ni gzung ba'i phyir// nas/ rdzogs pa'i bar gyis cho ga rnams kyi don bsdu/ skal ldan lam 'di 'dzin pa gang*// nga yis lung bstan gyur pa yin// rgyud kyi gsang ba 'di 'dzin pa dag rgyal bas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nang na/ skal ba bzang po'o zhes lung bstan no zhes/ rig pa 'dzin pa pad+ma dkar po rje btsun bla ma dang chos skyong nyid kyis gsang ba 'chad par bskos pa na/ dpal 'brug pa'i legs par bshad pa'i gsang mi gtol ba'i mthu med nas rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba 'di/ phyogs re'i mig skyon gyis log par rtog pa dag la snying rje'i blo kho nas lung gtso bor bton te pho brang yang rtse'i sa'i char sbyar ba yin no// legs bshad nyin 'dis kun shes mig bye tshe// phyogs lhung 'ug pa'i tshogs long yib gyur pa// thub bstan 'dab rgyas shes te ke sa ra'i// gad mo chen mos 'debs pa kun tu khyab/// /maṅgalaṃ/// /
